  4. Paradox Theory: Costs 1M Science, 40 Time Crystals, and 250 Void. Researching this is what officially unlocks the Chronocontrol time structure and enables the Chronosurge upgrade to be researched.

Step 2: Build a Chronocontrol Station

Before you can purchase the Chronosurge upgrade in your Workshop, you must construct at least one Chronocontrol structure:

  • Location: Under the Time tab (in the Void Space section).
  • Construction Cost: 30 Time Crystals, 500 Void, and 3,000 Temporal Flux.
  • Operating Cost: Consumes 15 Watts (Wt) of energy to run.

Step 3: Purchase Chronosurge

Once you have built your first Chronocontrol, the Chronosurge upgrade will appear in your Workshop. It requires a significant amount of endgame resources to craft:

  • Upgrade Cost:
    • 25 Time Crystals
    • 100k Unobtainium
    • 750 Void
    • 6,500 Temporal Flux

The Active Flux Loop (How It Works)

Once Chronosurge is active, your Chronospheres will actively generate 1 unit of Temporal Flux every calendar year.

Because shattering (combusting) a Time Crystal immediately advances the calendar by one full year, every single shatter you perform will instantly reward you with 1 Temporal Flux per active Chronosphere. This completely removes the bottleneck of waiting in “offline” mode or pausing your game to accumulate flux, allowing you to instantly generate thousands of units of temporal flux for advanced loops (such as repairing Cryochambers).

item.title: Temporal Battery
item.description:
In Kittens Game, the Temporal Battery is a crucial Time tab upgrade designed to expand your temporal storage limits so you can utilize advanced temporal mechanics.

Core Mechanics & Costs

  • Where to find it: The Time tab, which is unlocked after you research the Calendar technology.
  • The Cost: Constructing your first Temporal Battery costs 5 Time Crystals.
  • The Price Ratio: It has a price ratio of 1.25, meaning each subsequent level will cost 25% more Time Crystals than the last (e.g., the second level costs 6.25 TCs).
  • The Effect: Every level of Temporal Battery you purchase permanently increases your maximum Temporal Flux capacity by +25%.

Why You Need to Increase Your Temporal Flux Capacity

A high capacity for Temporal Flux is necessary to interact with two major late-game/end-game systems:
item.content:encoded:
In Kittens Game, the Temporal Battery is a crucial Time tab upgrade designed to expand your temporal storage limits so you can utilize advanced temporal mechanics.

Core Mechanics & Costs

  • Where to find it: The Time tab, which is unlocked after you research the Calendar technology.
  • The Cost: Constructing your first Temporal Battery costs 5 Time Crystals.
  • The Price Ratio: It has a price ratio of 1.25, meaning each subsequent level will cost 25% more Time Crystals than the last (e.g., the second level costs 6.25 TCs).
  • The Effect: Every level of Temporal Battery you purchase permanently increases your maximum Temporal Flux capacity by +25%.

Why You Need to Increase Your Temporal Flux Capacity

A high capacity for Temporal Flux is necessary to interact with two major late-game/end-game systems:

  1. Repairing Cryochambers (The Paragon/Kitten Carrying Loop): When you reset your game, each active Chronosphere lets you carry over a kitten in a Cryochamber, but this leaves the chambers in an unsealed “used” state. To repair a Used Cryochamber back to operating condition, you must pay 3,000 Temporal Flux, 100 Time Crystals, and 500 Void. If you plan to carry over dozens of kittens (e.g., up to 71 kittens) to rapidly accumulate Paragon right at the start of a reset, you must build numerous Temporal Batteries to accommodate the massive temporal flux storage requirements.
  2. Extended Use of Tempus Fugit: Tempus Fugit allows you to accelerate the game’s tick rate and calendar speed by 50%, enabling you to collect resources much faster. However, running this active boost is incredibly expensive, consuming 5 temporal flux per second. A tiny capacity cap will cause your reserve to evaporate almost instantly.

How to Fill Your Upgraded Battery

While the Temporal Battery only increases your maximum capacity, you can generate the actual Temporal Flux to fill it through several methods:

  • Offline Redshift (Passive): By default, you earn 5 units of temporal flux per minute while the game is completely closed or paused.
  • Temporal Accelerators (Redshift Boost): This Time tab upgrade (costing 10 Time Crystals and 1,000 Relics) permanently increases the flux generated from offline redshift by 5%.
  • Chronosurge (Active): Once you purchase this upgrade, your Chronospheres will actively generate 1 temporal flux per year on the calendar, letting you harvest flux actively rather than relying on offline wait times.

  7. Dune: ⍫

  10. Kairo: ℣

Each cycle lasts for five years. The active glyph will dynamically change color to let you know exactly which year of the current cycle you are in:

item.title: Black Hand
item.description:
The Invisible Black Hand (often referred to simply as the “black hand”) is a highly specialized, late-game Workshop upgrade. According to its humorous in-game description, it “is leading the blackcoin market: usually smoothly, but it can punch the market in the face if angry” (and no, it is “not related to the Invisible Pink Unicorn”).

How to Unlock and Purchase It

To unlock the upgrade, you must first research the Blackchain technology (which requires Quantum Cryptography). Once unlocked, purchasing the Invisible Black Hand from your Workshop costs:
item.content:encoded:
The Invisible Black Hand (often referred to simply as the “black hand”) is a highly specialized, late-game Workshop upgrade. According to its humorous in-game description, it “is leading the blackcoin market: usually smoothly, but it can punch the market in the face if angry” (and no, it is “not related to the Invisible Pink Unicorn”).

How to Unlock and Purchase It

To unlock the upgrade, you must first research the Blackchain technology (which requires Quantum Cryptography). Once unlocked, purchasing the Invisible Black Hand from your Workshop costs:

  • 128 Time Crystals
  • 64 Blackcoin
  • 32 Void
  • 4,096 Temporal Flux

The Core Effect

The upgrade grants you a powerful active ability: the option to force a Blackcoin market crash at the cost of 1 Time Crystal.

Strategic Value: Market Manipulation

Normally, Blackcoin (bcoin) acts as a speculative asset that you buy and sell from the Leviathans (Elders) in exchange for Relics. Its market price naturally fluctuates over time. Additionally, simply holding blackcoins in your inventory provides a +10% bonus to your kittens’ happiness.

However, the Invisible Black Hand lets you actively manipulate the bcoin market to exponentially grow your Relic stockpile:

  1. Force the Crash: Pay a Time Crystal to instantly crash the market, driving the price of Blackcoin down to its absolute floor.
  2. Buy Low: Use your Relics to buy up a massive amount of Blackcoin at this rock-bottom price.
  3. Sell High: Wait as the market “smoothly” recovers and the price rises back up. Once bcoin peaks, trade it all back to the Leviathans for a massive, multiplied return on your original Relic investment.

This “buy-low, sell-high” cycle is one of the fastest ways to generate hundreds of thousands of Relics in the late game.

📊 I can help you map out the production steps of the “Relic Era” to ensure you have the automated Relic generation required to afford the 4,096 Relics needed for Blackchain.

item.title: Black Coin
item.description:
In Kittens Game, Blackcoin (often referred to as bcoin) is a speculative late-game cryptocurrency.

Here is a breakdown of how this unique resource works, how you unlock it, and how you can manipulate its market for massive profits:

1. What is Blackcoin?

Unlike standard resources that you produce via buildings or jobs, Blackcoin is strictly traded. It acts as a speculative asset that you buy and sell from the Leviathans (Elders) in exchange for Relics.
item.content:encoded:
In Kittens Game, Blackcoin (often referred to as bcoin) is a speculative late-game cryptocurrency.

Here is a breakdown of how this unique resource works, how you unlock it, and how you can manipulate its market for massive profits:

1. What is Blackcoin?

Unlike standard resources that you produce via buildings or jobs, Blackcoin is strictly traded. It acts as a speculative asset that you buy and sell from the Leviathans (Elders) in exchange for Relics.

Because the price of Blackcoin fluctuates dynamically over time, the primary strategy is to treat it like a real-world stock: buy it when the price is low, and cash it out for a massive return in Relics when the price peaks.

2. Unlocking Blackcoin

To enter the cryptocurrency market, you must follow a specific late-game research path:

  • First, research Artificial Intelligence and its follow-up, Quantum Cryptography.
  • This unlocks the Blackchain technology, which costs 5,000,000 Science and 4,096 Relics.
  • Researching Blackchain officially unlocks Blackcoin and opens up its market.

3. Market Manipulation: The “Invisible Black Hand”

Once you have unlocked Blackchain, you can purchase a powerful Workshop upgrade called the Invisible Black Hand.

  • Cost: 128 Time Crystals, 64 Blackcoin, 32 Void, and 4,096 Temporal Flux.
  • The Effect: This upgrade represents the force “leading the blackcoin market”. Crucially, it grants you the option to force a market crash at the cost of Time Crystals.

By strategically forcing crashes with the Invisible Black Hand, you can bottom out the coin’s value, buy up as much Blackcoin as possible with your Relics, wait for the market to naturally recover (or smoothly rise), and then sell it back to the Leviathans to multiply your endgame Relic stockpile exponentially.

item.title: Creating Relics
item.description:
Phase 1: Gathering Your First Relics (The “Type 0” Relic Engine)

Before you can automate Relics, you have to obtain your first few manually through Leviathan trading.

  1. Climb the Unicorn Tree: Sacrifice Unicorns in the Religion tab to get Unicorn Tears. Accumulate 10,000 tears and click “Refine Tears” to create 1 Sorrow (Black Liquid Sorrow / BLS).
  2. Build Black Pyramids: Purchase the Megalomania upgrade in the Metaphysics tab (costs 10 Paragon) to unlock Ziggurat space-religion structures. Once you have refined 5 BLS, construct your first Black Pyramid.
  3. Trade with the Elders: Once you own a Black Pyramid, the Leviathans (Elders) will begin randomly appearing in your Trade tab. Trade 5,000 Unobtainium to them; each trade has a 98% chance to give you Time Crystals and a 5% chance to award a Relic.
  4. Acquire 6 Relics: Trade until you have secured 6 Relics. You will need 5 Relics to research Cryptotheology and 1 Relic to research Tachyon Theory on your Science tree.

Phase 2: Transitioning to Space and Antimatter

Now you need to establish the infrastructure required to store and generate Antimatter, which acts as the power source for automated Relics.
item.content:encoded:
Phase 1: Gathering Your First Relics (The “Type 0” Relic Engine)

Before you can automate Relics, you have to obtain your first few manually through Leviathan trading.

  1. Climb the Unicorn Tree: Sacrifice Unicorns in the Religion tab to get Unicorn Tears. Accumulate 10,000 tears and click “Refine Tears” to create 1 Sorrow (Black Liquid Sorrow / BLS).
  2. Build Black Pyramids: Purchase the Megalomania upgrade in the Metaphysics tab (costs 10 Paragon) to unlock Ziggurat space-religion structures. Once you have refined 5 BLS, construct your first Black Pyramid.
  3. Trade with the Elders: Once you own a Black Pyramid, the Leviathans (Elders) will begin randomly appearing in your Trade tab. Trade 5,000 Unobtainium to them; each trade has a 98% chance to give you Time Crystals and a 5% chance to award a Relic.
  4. Acquire 6 Relics: Trade until you have secured 6 Relics. You will need 5 Relics to research Cryptotheology and 1 Relic to research Tachyon Theory on your Science tree.

Phase 2: Transitioning to Space and Antimatter

Now you need to establish the infrastructure required to store and generate Antimatter, which acts as the power source for automated Relics.

  1. Research Technologies: Research Cryptotheology (costs 650k Science and 5 Relics) to unlock the Cryptotheology tab and enable the Relic Station upgrade. Research Tachyon Theory (costs 750k Science, 25 Time Crystals, and 1 Relic) to unlock the Chronoforge.
  2. Generate Antimatter: Build Sunlifters in Helios. If your overall energy grid has a positive surplus, Sunlifters will automatically generate 1 Antimatter every time the game transitions to a new calendar year. You can speed this up by shattering (combusting) Time Crystals to skip years instantly.
  3. Expand Antimatter Storage: Construct Containment Chambers (and Heatsinks) in Helios to expand your maximum Antimatter storage capacity to at least 5,000.
    • Note: Upgrading Space Beacons into Relic Stations requires a 5,000 Antimatter cap. If your maximum Antimatter cap falls below 5,000, your automated relic production is penalized by 0.02% for every missing unit.

Phase 3: Automated Production (The “Type 1” Relic Engine)

At this stage, you transition away from trading for Relics and set up an automated production engine.

  1. Unlock Relic Stations: Once your Antimatter cap is 5,000 and you have 100 Eludium, purchase the Relic Station upgrade in your Workshop. This upgrades your Space Beacons to automatically generate Relics.
  2. Deploy Space Beacons: Build and max out your Space Beacons in Kairo. Each Beacon will now automatically generate 0.01 relics per day.
  3. Amplify Your Output: Boost your daily Relic production with Cryptotheology upgrades:
    • Black Nexus: Costs 5,000 Relics. Each Black Nexus you buy increases your Relic Station output by +10% per Black Pyramid you own. It also increases the yield when you manually refine Time Crystals into Relics.
    • Black Cores: Costs 10,000 Relics. These increase your maximum BLS capacity, allowing you to hoard more Sorrow and build more Black Pyramids to multiply your Black Nexus bonus.

Phase 4: Quantum Hash Scaling and Blackchain

The final stretch uses quantum computing to boost your Relic Stations even further and reach the 4,096 threshold.

  1. Research Quantum Cryptography: Once you accumulate 1,024 Relics, research Quantum Cryptography (costs 1.25M Science and 1,024 Relics). This unlocks Entanglement Stations and AI Cores.
  2. Farm Hashrate Levels: AI Cores generate Gigaflops, and Entanglement Stations consume Gigaflops to produce Hashes. Each Hashrate Level provides a multiplicative +25% bonus to your automated Space Beacon relic production.
  3. Unlock Blackchain: Accumulate Relics from your boosted Space Beacons (and time-skipping) until you have 4,096 Relics and 5,000,000 Science. Research Blackchain to permanently unlock the Blackcoin market.

⚖️ I can help you map out the perfect ratio of AI Cores to Entanglement Stations so you can generate Hashes at maximum speed without accidentally triggering the AI Apocalypse.

item.title: Transkittenism vs necrocracy vs radical xenophobia
item.description:
In Kittens Game, Transkittenism, Necrocracy, and Radical Xenophobia are mutually exclusive late-game policies available after you have traded with the Leviathans. You can only pick one per run, and they cannot be changed once selected.

Because they are exclusive, choosing one requires identifying your primary bottleneck: storage capacity, raw production, or specific resource pacts.

Comparison Overview

Policy Primary Focus Key Benefit
Transkittenism Storage Increases Moon Base storage capacity (which effectively allows for more Chronospheres).
Necrocracy Production Global production bonus based on your Black Liquid Sorrow (BLS) levels.
Radical Xenophobia Diplomacy/Pacts Increases Mausoleum efficiency and grants 5 free Pacts.

Deep Dive

1. Transkittenism (The “Storage” Choice)

  • Best for: Players aiming for “Chronosphere amplification” or pushing to reach higher kitten counts through storage-based building limits.
  • The Effect: It doubles Gigaflop output. Because Gigaflops are used to maintain Entanglement Stations (which boost relic output) and affect Moon Base storage, it helps you manage higher building caps.
  • Why pick it: If you are planning a very long run where you want to maximize the number of Chronospheres you can build, the extra storage from Moon Bases provided by Transkittenism is often the superior choice.

2. Necrocracy (The “Production” Choice)

  • Best for: Players who have significant Black Liquid Sorrow (BLS) and want to maximize Unobtainium, ivory, and alicorn production.
  • The Effect: Provides a global production bonus of 0.1% per 1% of BLS. It also boosts your Leviathan Energy Cap by 5%.
  • Why pick it: If your main limitation is the speed at which you generate resources (Unobtainium being the most common), Necrocracy is mathematically superior in the late game. As your BLS increases over multiple runs, this bonus scales significantly, potentially tripling your Unobtainium production.

3. Radical Xenophobia (The “Niche” Choice)

  • Best for: Very specific scenarios where you need Pacts or want to maximize the efficacy of your Mausoleums.
  • The Effect: Increases the efficacy of all Mausoleums and gives 5 free Pacts.
  • Why pick it: This is generally considered the weakest of the three for most standard gameplay goals. It is mostly used if you specifically need the Pacts for a challenge or a very unconventional setup.

Strategic Recommendation

  • Early/Mid-Late Game: If you don’t have much BLS built up yet, Transkittenism is often preferred for the storage flexibility.
  • Deep/Infinite Runs: Once you have high levels of BLS (usually 250+), Necrocracy typically outperforms Transkittenism by providing a massive, multiplicative production boost to your entire economy, including space structures.
  • Note on AI Apocalypse: Be aware that Necrocracy can make managing the AI Apocalypse more complex because it increases your reliance on the resources that trigger it. If you want to avoid the headache of managing AI cores vs. Entanglement stations, some players stick with Transkittenism purely for the “lazier” late-game management.

Summary: If you aren’t sure, Transkittenism is generally safer and more flexible for storage, while Necrocracy is the “power gamer” move for when your production speed (specifically Unobtainium) becomes your primary blocker.

item.title: Outer Space Treaty vs Military Space
item.description:
In Kittens Game, Outer Space Treaty and Militarize Space are mutually exclusive Foreign policies that become available after you launch your first Satellite. Both cost 10,000 Culture to unlock, and picking one will permanently lock you out of the other for the rest of your run.

Here is a comparison of their effects and the community’s strategic advice on when to choose them:

Outer Space Treaty

  • The Effect: This policy establishes that space is the domain of all races, which improves your standing with all trading partners. The boost is equivalent to having 10 extra Tradeposts.
  • When to choose it: Community guides generally recommend picking Outer Space Treaty for most standard situations. Trade is a fundamental pillar of the mid-to-late game economy, making the diplomatic relations boost consistently useful.

Militarize Space

  • The Effect: This policy turns your satellites into military research hubs. It makes the maximum science capacity bonus that your Satellites provide to your Observatories 10% more powerful.
  • When to choose it: You should pick Militarize Space specifically if you find that your progression is constantly being blocked by your maximum science limit. The extra capacity boost can help you afford expensive space structures and technologies when your science storage is bottlenecked.

item.title: Solar Satellites
item.description:
In Kittens Game, Solar Satellites is a highly useful Workshop upgrade that fundamentally changes how your Satellites interact with your power grid.

Here is a breakdown of its prerequisites, costs, and effects:

  • Prerequisites and Cost: To unlock the Solar Satellites upgrade, you must first research the Orbital Engineering technology. Purchasing the upgrade in the Workshop costs 225,000 Science and 750 Alloy.
  • The Effect: By default, every Satellite you deploy in Cath orbit consumes 1 Watt of energy. The Solar Satellites upgrade completely reverses this, transforming your Satellites into dedicated power generators. After purchasing it, each Satellite will instead permanently generate 1 Watt of energy.
  • The Trade-off: The only minor restriction is that once this upgrade is purchased, your Satellites become permanently active and can no longer be toggled off. However, since they are now feeding power into your grid rather than draining it, there is virtually no reason you would ever want to turn them off.

Ultimately, this upgrade provides a massive net positive for your late-game energy grid, effectively resulting in a +2 energy swing for every single Satellite you own!

item.title: Singularity
item.description:
In Kittens Game, the Singularity is a high-level Metaphysics upgrade that serves as a massive force multiplier for your late-game resource production. It represents the point where your civilization’s technological and spiritual progress merge into a single, unstoppable advancement.

Key Effects

The Singularity is unique because it provides a global production bonus that scales with your total number of Metaphysics upgrades:

  • Global Production Bonus: It provides a +5% bonus to all production.
  • The “Price Ratio” Capstone: While upgrades like Golden Ratio and Vitruvian Feline reduce the price of buildings, Singularity is often the final “big purchase” players make in the Metaphysics tree before focusing entirely on Paragon hoarding or Cryptotheology.
  • Multiplier Synergy: This 5% is multiplicative. In your current stage—dealing with Enriched Uranium and Temporal Distortion—this small percentage translates to massive raw gains in Unobtainium, Antimatter, and Void.

Unlock Requirements & Cost

To see Singularity in your Metaphysics tab, you must have progressed through the “feline” hierarchy of upgrades (Malkuth, Yesod, etc.):
item.content:encoded:
In Kittens Game, the Singularity is a high-level Metaphysics upgrade that serves as a massive force multiplier for your late-game resource production. It represents the point where your civilization’s technological and spiritual progress merge into a single, unstoppable advancement.

Key Effects

The Singularity is unique because it provides a global production bonus that scales with your total number of Metaphysics upgrades:

  • Global Production Bonus: It provides a +5% bonus to all production.
  • The “Price Ratio” Capstone: While upgrades like Golden Ratio and Vitruvian Feline reduce the price of buildings, Singularity is often the final “big purchase” players make in the Metaphysics tree before focusing entirely on Paragon hoarding or Cryptotheology.
  • Multiplier Synergy: This 5% is multiplicative. In your current stage—dealing with Enriched Uranium and Temporal Distortion—this small percentage translates to massive raw gains in Unobtainium, Antimatter, and Void.

Unlock Requirements & Cost

To see Singularity in your Metaphysics tab, you must have progressed through the “feline” hierarchy of upgrades (Malkuth, Yesod, etc.):

Requirement Type Cost / Detail
Metaphysics Tab Requires Astronomy, Philosophy, and a Ziggurat.
Zodiac Prerequisite You must have purchased the Zodiac upgrade first.
Paragon Resource 250 Paragon

Strategic Context

Given that you are managing complex late-game systems, the Singularity is essentially your “end-game” badge for a standard run.

  1. Paragon Management: 250 Paragon is a significant investment. You should only buy Singularity if you already have the core Price Ratio upgrades (Engineering, Golden Ratio, Vitruvian Feline, Renaissance). If you don’t have those, the price reduction they offer is mathematically superior to the 5% production boost from Singularity.
  2. The Dark Future: If you are pushing toward Year 40,000+ (the Dark Future), every percentage point matters. Singularity helps counteract the production penalties that can occur when Temporal Distortion gets out of hand.
  3. Reset Planning: Since Metaphysics upgrades are permanent, buying Singularity makes every subsequent run 5% faster from the very first minute. It makes the “early game slog” almost non-existent.

Expert Tip: If you are currently farming Void, the 5% bonus from Singularity also applies to the effectiveness of your Void Resonators, slightly increasing the frequency of your paradoxes and your total Void yield.

Summary: Should you buy it now?

  • YES: If you have over 750 total Paragon and already own Renaissance.
  • NO: If you are still struggling to lower building prices. Save that Paragon for Renaissance (750 Paragon) first; it is the single most powerful upgrade in the game.

item.title: Satellite_Radio
item.description:
In Kittens Game, Satellite Radio is a game-changing Workshop upgrade that transforms your Satellites from simple starchart generators into critical scientific infrastructure.

Key Effects

The primary function of Satellite Radio is to expand your Science Cap:

  • Science Max Bonus: Each Satellite you own now increases your maximum science capacity.
  • Scaling: The amount of science added per satellite is influenced by other upgrades (like Satellite Navigation) and your total number of Libraries and Academies.
  • The “Science Wall”: This is the most effective way to reach the massive science caps (250k+) required for late-game technologies like Nuclear Fission, Nanotechnology, and Antimatter.

Unlock Requirements & Cost

To see this upgrade in your Workshop, you must have moved into the orbital era:

To see this upgrade in your Workshop, you must have moved into the orbital era:

Requirement Type Cost / Detail
Orbital Engineering Technology The primary scientific prerequisite.
Satellite Space Building You must have at least one Satellite deployed.
Science Resource 125,000 Science
Alloy Resource 2,500 Alloy

Strategic Importance

Given your current focus on Enriched Uranium and Temporal Distortion, Satellite Radio is likely the reason you were able to progress this far. Here is how it fits into your current late-game loop:

  1. Preparation for Antimatter: To research Advanced Physics and build Containment Chambers, you need science caps in the hundreds of thousands. While Compendiums provide a flat boost, Satellite Radio provides a scalable boost that grows as you expand your space presence.
  2. Synergy with Navigation Upgrades: Every time you buy an upgrade that improves “Satellite Efficiency” (like Navigation Relay or Satellite Navigation), the science cap bonus from Satellite Radio also increases.
  3. Space Elevator Efficiency: Since you are using Space Elevators to reduce launch costs, you can spam more Satellites for relatively low oil costs, which in turn balloons your science cap.

Comparison: Science Cap Sources

Source Type Scaling
Compendiums Resource Linear (10 per unit)
BioLabs Building Exponential (High science/alloy cost)
Satellite Radio Upgrade Dynamic (Based on Satellite count)

Pro Tip: If you are hitting a science cap and can’t afford the next big tech, don’t just build more Libraries. Launch 5 more Satellites. Thanks to Satellite Radio, it’s often the most resource-efficient way to move the needle on your science maximum.

item.title: Satellite Navigation
item.description:
In Kittens Game, Satellite Navigation is a late-mid-game Workshop upgrade that serves as a vital bridge between your early space exploration and the industrialization of the solar system.

It is specifically designed to solve the Starchart bottleneck that occurs when you begin reaching for distant bodies like Jupiter, Saturn, and Centaurus.

Key Effects

The primary function of Satellite Navigation is to increase the throughput of your orbital network:

  • Satellite Efficiency: It provides a +25% bonus to the effectiveness of your Satellites.
  • Starchart Production: Since Satellites are your primary source of passive Starcharts (alongside Observatories), this upgrade drastically increases your income.
  • Science Cap: If you have researched Satellite Radio, this efficiency boost also increases the Maximum Science provided by your Satellites, helping you reach the caps needed for Antimatter.

Unlock Requirements & Cost

To see this upgrade in your Workshop, you must have moved past basic Rocketry and into deeper orbital mechanics:

Given your current focus on Enriched Uranium and Temporal Distortion, Satellite Navigation is a high-priority “logistics” upgrade:

  1. Fueling the Farther Ring: Missions to the outer planets require thousands of Starcharts. This upgrade, combined with the Navigation Relay and Hubble Space Telescope, is what allows you to launch those missions without waiting hours for the data to accumulate.
  2. Unobtainium Scaling: To get more Unobtainium, you need more Lunar Outposts. To build those, you need Alloy and Starcharts. Satellite Navigation ensures your “map data” (Starcharts) never prevents you from expanding your Unobtainium mines.

item.title: SETI
item.description:
In Kittens Game, SETI (Search for Extraterrestrial Intelligence) is one of the most beloved “Quality of Life” upgrades in the Workshop. It marks a major turning point where your astronomical observations transition from manual clicking to full automation.

Key Effects

The primary function of SETI is to automate the gathering of astronomical data:

  • Auto-Observation: Normally, you have to manually click the “A celestial event has occurred” button to get Starcharts. SETI automatically clicks this button for you with 100% success.
  • Starchart Generation: Because it never misses an event, your Starchart production becomes a steady, passive stream.
  • Science Bonus: It provides a small bonus to your overall science production (usually around +5%) by streamlining how your astronomers process data.

Unlock Requirements & Cost

To see SETI in your Workshop, you must have advanced into the early space-age technologies:

Requirement Type Cost / Detail
Electronics Technology The primary scientific prerequisite.
Science Resource 125,000 Science
Titanium Resource 250 Titanium

Strategic Context

Given your current focus on Enriched Uranium and Space Exploration, SETI is a non-negotiable upgrade for your stage of the game:

  1. Automation of the Grind: Before SETI, your Starchart income is limited by your attention span. After SETI, you can leave the game running (idling) and return to thousands of Starcharts, which are essential for those “Long Range Spaceships” and Jupiter missions we discussed.
  2. Synergy with Satellites: SETI works beautifully with your Satellites and the Navigation Relay. While Satellites increase the amount of science/starcharts per event, SETI ensures you never miss an event.
  3. End of “Signals Interference”: In older versions or specific challenges, manual clicking is hindered by “interference.” SETI effectively bypasses these mechanics, providing a clean data stream.

Expert Tip: If you find your Starchart production is still slow even with SETI, make sure you’ve built more Observatories. SETI only automates the event; the frequency of those events is determined by your total number of Observatories.

item.title: Reactor_Vessel
item.description:
In Kittens Game, the Reactor Vessel is a high-level Workshop upgrade that enhances your industrial efficiency by improving the storage and processing capabilities of your Reactors.

Key Effects

The Reactor Vessel represents an upgrade to the physical containment of your nuclear systems, allowing them to operate at higher capacities:

  • Production Bonus: It provides a +5% production bonus to all resources generated by your Reactors.
  • Storage Increase: It increases the maximum amount of Uranium and Thorium your Reactors can hold. This is vital for long-duration automated play, ensuring your reactors don’t stall because they’ve hit their local storage caps.
  • Efficiency: This is a multiplicative bonus, meaning it scales with your other late-game multipliers like Solar Revolution and Magnetos.

Unlock Requirements & Cost

To see this upgrade in your Workshop, you must have advanced through the Nuclear Fission branch:

Strategic Context

Given your current focus on Enriched Uranium and Temporal Distortion, the Reactor Vessel is a “throughput” upgrade.

  1. Fueling the Enriched Uranium Grind: Since you are currently crafting Enriched Uranium (which costs 500 Uranium per unit), the increased storage provided by the Reactor Vessel helps prevent your standard Uranium from “overflowing” and being wasted before you can craft it.
  2. Antimatter Stabilization: Better storage and efficiency in your Reactors mean a more stable power grid. Since Containment Chambers for Antimatter require a constant power surplus, this upgrade helps smooth out any energy dips caused by fluctuating resource production.
  3. Path to Thorium: This is often a bridge upgrade taken before moving into Thorium Reactors. By maximizing your standard Reactor efficiency first, you ensure a smoother transition to the more powerful Thorium-based economy.

Pro Tip: While 5,000 Uranium is a steep cost, the 5% global production boost to the Reactors’ output (including their energy generation) makes this one of the most cost-effective ways to squeeze more power out of your existing grid.

item.title: Quantum_Cryptography
item.description:
In Kittens Game, Quantum Cryptography is a high-level technology that marks your entry into the final stages of the scientific and digital era. It represents an evolution in data security and processing that is essential for managing your late-game infrastructure.

Key Effects

Quantum Cryptography is primarily a “gateway” technology that unlocks several advanced upgrades and buildings:

  • Entanglement Station: This is the most critical building unlocked by this tech. It is your primary defense against the AI Apocalypse. Entanglement Stations consume Gigaflops generated by your AI Cores, allowing you to keep your AI level stable while still benefiting from the massive science boosts they provide.
  • Quantum Computing: A Workshop upgrade that significantly increases your Science cap and the efficiency of your Data Centers. This is vital for reaching the multi-million science requirements of Relic and Void tech.
  • AI Core Efficiency: It improves the synergy between your computers and your kittens, allowing for more precise resource management in the late game.

Unlock Requirements & Cost

To research Quantum Cryptography, you must have a mastery of both advanced physics and computing:

Unlock Requirements & Cost

To research Quantum Cryptography, you must have a mastery of both advanced physics and computing:

Requirement Type Cost / Detail
Artificial Intelligence Technology The base requirement for all digital upgrades.
Particle Physics Technology Required for the “Quantum” aspect of the tech.
Science Resource 200,000 Science
Blueprints Resource 500 Blueprints

Strategic Importance

Given your current focus on Enriched Uranium and Temporal Distortion, Quantum Cryptography is the technology that will allow you to scale your AI Cores safely.

  1. AI Apocalypse Prevention: As we discussed regarding Machine Learning, AI Cores are powerful but dangerous. Quantum Cryptography provides the Entanglement Stations needed to “burn” your AI’s Gigaflops, keeping the AI level below 15 and preventing the destruction of your resources.
  2. The Science Ceiling: By unlocking Quantum Computing, you can push your Science cap high enough to research Chronotheology and Void Space, which are the keys to managing the Distortion you’ve been seeing.
  3. Late-Game Crafting: The Blueprint cost (500) is steep, but by this point, your Nuclear Smelters and Geologists should be providing enough gold and minerals to trade with Leviathans or craft the blueprints manually.

Pro Tip: Do not build more than 1-2 AI Cores until you have researched Quantum Cryptography and built at least one Entanglement Station. The AI level rises quickly, and without a way to reduce it, you risk losing your entire Uranium stock.

item.title: Orbital Geodesy
item.description:
In Kittens Game, Orbital Geodesy is a high-level Workshop upgrade that significantly enhances the effectiveness of your Geologists. It represents the application of satellite data to terrestrial mining, allowing your kittens to locate and extract minerals with surgical precision.

Key Effects

The primary benefit of Orbital Geodesy is a massive increase in your resource production, specifically targeting the rarest ground-based minerals:

  • Geologist Efficiency: It provides a +50% bonus to all production from Geologists.
  • Gold Production: Geologists are your main source of Gold on the ground. This upgrade is essential for funding the late-game Gold requirements for trading and high-level buildings.
  • Unobtainium Synergy: While it doesn’t produce Unobtainium directly, the increased Gold production allows you to trade more frequently with Leviathans, which is the fastest way to get Time Crystals and Relics for your Cryptotheology.

Unlock Requirements & Cost

To see Orbital Geodesy in your Workshop, you must have advanced through the Orbital Engineering and Geology branches:

Given your current progress with Enriched Uranium and Temporal Distortion, Orbital Geodesy is a critical “economic” upgrade:

  1. Trading Mastery: As you move into the Dark Future, you will need vast amounts of Gold to bribe the Leviathans. Orbital Geodesy ensures your Gold income can support dozens of trades per year.
  2. Resource Balancing: By the time you reach this upgrade, your Miners and Smelters are already highly efficient. Orbital Geodesy brings your Geologists up to that same elite level, rounding out your terrestrial economy.
  3. Path to the Exotic: This upgrade is often a stepping stone toward the most advanced resource-gathering technologies in the Farther Ring, ensuring you have the “old world” resources needed to build “new world” colonies.

Pro Tip: Pair this upgrade with the Mining Drill we discussed. The combined bonus to both Miners and Geologists will effectively end any mineral-related bottlenecks you are currently facing.

item.title: Orbital_Engineering
item.description:
In Kittens Game, Orbital Engineering is a pivotal mid-to-late game technology that transitions your civilization from surface-based industry to a true spacefaring empire. It is the primary gateway to the Space tab’s most influential infrastructure.

Key Effects

Unlocking Orbital Engineering allows you to begin building and upgrading your orbital presence, specifically focusing on science and logistics:

  • Space Elevator: This is the most critical building unlocked by this tech. It drastically reduces the oil cost of launching space missions. Without it, the oil requirements for reaching the Farther Ring (like Jupiter) quickly become impossible to meet.
  • Satellite Radio: A Workshop upgrade that allows your Satellites to increase your Science cap. This is vital for reaching the science levels needed for Antimatter.
  • Navigation Relay: As we discussed earlier, this upgrade boosts Satellite effectiveness by +15%, further accelerating your Starchart and Science generation.

Unlock Requirements & Cost

To research Orbital Engineering, you must have a solid foundation in both electronics and rocketry:

Blueprints Resource 250 Blueprints

Strategic Importance

Given your current focus on Enriched Uranium and Temporal Distortion, Orbital Engineering is the technology that likely enabled your current progress.

  1. Breaking the Oil Barrier: Before this tech, your space expansion is limited by how much oil you can store and produce. The Space Elevator (unlocked here) is what allows you to bypass that bottleneck and launch the heavy missions required for Unobtainium.
  2. Science Scaling: By allowing Satellites to contribute to your Science cap, this technology provides the “storage” needed to research Nuclear Fission and Nanotechnology.
  3. Path to the Moon: While you can reach the Moon with just Rocketry, Orbital Engineering makes Lunar Outposts much more sustainable by reducing the logistical overhead of getting there.

Pro Tip: Once you have this tech, prioritize building at least 5-10 Space Elevators. The cumulative oil reduction is what makes late-game missions to Charon or Centaurus feasible.

item.title: Nuclear_Smelters
item.description:
In Kittens Game, the Nuclear Smelter is a high-level Workshop upgrade that provides a massive efficiency boost to your metal production by integrating nuclear technology into your existing industrial infrastructure.

Key Effects

The Nuclear Smelter upgrade transforms your Smelters into far more productive units:

  • Production Bonus: It increases the production of Iron and Gold from each Smelter by +25%.
  • Scaling: This is a multiplicative bonus that stacks with other Smelter upgrades (like Electrolytic Smelting). In the late game, this boost is critical for sustaining the massive Iron and Gold requirements of Alloy and Blueprint crafting.
  • Coal Efficiency: While it increases metal output, it does not increase the coal consumption of the Smelters, making it a very “resource-efficient” upgrade for your industrial floor.

Unlock Requirements & Cost

To see Nuclear Smelters in your Workshop, you must have advanced through the Nuclear Fission technology branch:

item.title: Nuclear Plants
item.description:
In Kittens Game, the Nuclear Plant is a late-game upgrade for your Reactors that significantly increases your energy production to support advanced space and science facilities. It represents the transition from simple steam and coal power to high-density fission energy.

Key Effects

The Nuclear Plant is a Workshop upgrade that transforms your Reactors into more powerful units:

  • Energy Production: Each Reactor produces +25% more energy. This is essential for powering Containment Chambers (for Antimatter) and Lunar Outposts (for Unobtainium).
  • Uranium Consumption: While it boosts power, it also increases Uranium consumption for each Reactor. You must ensure your Uranium production (from Accelerators and Lunar Outposts) is strong enough to handle the extra drain.

Unlock Requirements & Cost

To see this upgrade in your Workshop, you must have advanced through the Nuclear Fission technology branch:

  2. Thorium Synergy: Once you unlock Thorium, you can further upgrade these plants to Thorium Reactors, which provide even more power and reduce the reliance on standard Uranium for energy.

Pro Tip: If your Uranium stocks start crashing after buying this upgrade, consider trading with Griffins or increasing your Lunar Outpost count to stabilize the supply.

item.title: Reinforced_Warehouses
item.description:
In Kittens Game, Reinforced Warehouses is a mid-game Workshop upgrade that helps solve your storage bottlenecks. As your civilization grows, your basic storage buildings (Barns and Warehouses) often can’t hold enough resources to afford expensive new technologies or space missions.

Key Effects

The primary function of Reinforced Warehouses is to expand your resource caps:

  • Storage Capacity: It increases the storage capacity of all your Warehouses by +25%.
  • Broad Impact: This affects almost all basic resources stored in Warehouses, including Wood, Minerals, Iron, Coal, and Gold.
  • Progression: This is the first of several Warehouse upgrades (followed by Titanium, Alloy, and Concrete versions) that allow you to reach the massive resource caps needed for late-game goals like Enriched Uranium or Space Elevators.

Requirements & Cost

To see this upgrade in your Workshop, you must have researched Construction.

  • Progression: This is the first of several Warehouse upgrades (followed by Titanium, Alloy, and Concrete versions) that allow you to reach the massive resource caps needed for late-game goals like Enriched Uranium or Space Elevators.

Requirements & Cost

To see this upgrade in your Workshop, you must have researched Construction.

Requirement Type Cost / Detail
Construction Technology The primary scientific prerequisite.
Warehouse Building You must have at least one Warehouse built.
Science Resource 10,000 Science
Iron Resource 2,000 Iron

Strategic Context

Given your current focus on Enriched Uranium and Distortion management, Reinforced Warehouses is a “foundational” upgrade you likely acquired long ago. However, its importance scales as you progress:

  1. Blueprint & Steel Farming: To craft the thousands of Blueprints and Steel needed for high-level industry, you need high storage caps to prevent your “raw” resources (Science and Minerals) from hitting their limits while you’re away.
  2. Unobtainium Scaling: Later upgrades in this series (like Titanium Warehouses) are essential for increasing your Unobtainium and Alloy caps, which directly limits how many Chronospheres or Space Beacons you can build.
  3. Efficiency: Instead of building 10 more physical Warehouses (which get more expensive with each one), this upgrade boosts your existing infrastructure for a flat science cost.

Pro Tip: If you find yourself frequently hitting your resource caps, check if you’ve also purchased the Expansions or Cargo Ships upgrades. Cargo Ships, in particular, provide a massive boost to Warehouse storage based on your total fleet size.

item.title: Navigation Relay
item.description:
Part of the locked Space Exploration Tee.

In Kittens Game, the Navigation Relay is a mid-to-late game Workshop upgrade that significantly enhances your space-based logistics. It is designed to work in tandem with your Satellites to make space exploration and resource management much more efficient.

Key Effects

The Navigation Relay serves as a force multiplier for your orbital network:

  • Satellite Efficiency: It provides a +15% bonus to the effectiveness of your Satellites.
  • Starchart Generation: Because it boosts Satellite efficiency, it indirectly increases your Starchart production. This is crucial for launching the “Long Range Spaceships” and outer-system missions like Jupiter and Saturn that we discussed earlier.
  • Energy Management: By making your existing Satellites more effective, you can often generate the starcharts you need without having to build as many individual units, saving you on the scaling Alloy and Science costs.

Unlock Requirements & Cost

To see the Navigation Relay in your Workshop, you must have advanced into the Space era:

Starcharts Resource 1,500 Starcharts

Strategic Context

Given your current focus on Enriched Uranium and managing Temporal Distortion, the Navigation Relay is a “maintenance” upgrade that ensures your foundation remains solid as you push into the Dark Future.

  1. Scaling for the Farther Ring: As missions to Jupiter and beyond require thousands of Starcharts, the 15% boost from the Navigation Relay (especially when stacked with the Hubble Space Telescope) is essential to prevent a “Starchart drought.”
  2. Antimatter Preparation: To build Containment Chambers for Antimatter, you need massive Science caps. Since Satellites contribute to your Science cap via the Satellite Radio upgrade, the Navigation Relay helps push those caps even higher.
  3. Efficiency: It is a relatively “cheap” upgrade compared to the cost of building 10 additional Satellites in the late game, making it a high-priority purchase after a reset.

Expert Tip: If you have already started farming Void, the Navigation Relay helps stabilize your Starchart income so you can keep your Research Vessels and Space Beacons active even when the timeline is experiencing Distortion.

item.title: Nanosuits
item.description:
In Kittens Game, the Nanosuit is a high-level Workshop upgrade that provides a massive boost to your environmental resilience and global production, particularly during the late-game stage you are in.

Key Effects

The Nanosuit represents an advanced layer of protection and efficiency for your kittens, allowing them to work more effectively regardless of environmental conditions:

  • Global Production Bonus: It provides a +2% bonus to all production. While 2% sounds small, in the late game, this is a multiplicative bonus that stacks with your Solar Revolution, Magnetos, and Relics, leading to a substantial increase in raw resource generation.
  • Environmental Protection: It drastically reduces the negative effects of Pollution on your kitten’s happiness and production. This is vital if you are running dozens of Reactors and Calciners to fuel your space industry.
  • Cold Resistance: It increases the effectiveness of your kittens during Winter, further stabilizing your catnip and wood production.

Unlock Requirements & Cost

To see the Nanosuit in your Workshop, you must have advanced through the Nanotechnology branch of the tech tree:

Unobtainium Resource 1,000 Unobtainium

Strategic Context

Given your current focus on Enriched Uranium and Distortion, the Nanosuit is a “foundation” upgrade for the Dark Future:

  1. Pollution Mitigation: As you scale your energy production for Antimatter, your pollution levels will naturally rise. The Nanosuit is one of the few ways to keep your kittens happy (and thus productive) without having to disable your heavy industry.
  2. Unobtainium Efficiency: Since it requires 1,000 Unobtainium, it is often a mid-priority upgrade. You should prioritize it once your Lunar Outpost production is stable (likely after getting the Microwarp Reactors we discussed).
  3. Path to the Exotic: The Nanosuit is a prerequisite for even more advanced suits and environmental controls that allow for more efficient exploration of the Farther Ring planets like Jupiter.

Pro Tip: If you are finding that your production drops significantly during the winter even with Iron Hoes, the Nanosuit’s environmental leveling will make your production curve much flatter and more predictable.

item.title: Mining Drill
item.description:
In Kittens Game, the Mining Drill is a vital mid-game Workshop upgrade that significantly boosts your mineral production, which is essential as you begin to scale your industrial infrastructure.

Key Effects

The Mining Drill provides a massive efficiency boost to your Miners:

  • Miner Efficiency: It increases the effectiveness of your Miners by +20%.
  • Production Scaling: This is a multiplicative bonus that affects the base production of every kitten assigned to the Miner job. As you stack more global production bonuses (like Magnetos or Solar Revolution), this 20% increase becomes a significant source of raw materials.

Unlock Requirements & Cost

To see the Mining Drill in your Workshop tab, you must have advanced through the early industrial technologies:

Strategic Context

Given your progress with Enriched Uranium and Machine Learning, the Mining Drill is a legacy upgrade that likely fueled your early transition into the Steel Age. Here is how it impacts your current high-level play:

  1. Steel Production: Since minerals are a primary ingredient for Steel (and later Alloy), the Mining Drill helps ensure your Smelters and Calciners never run out of raw ore.
  2. Concrete & Skyscrapers: In the mid-to-late game, your mineral needs skyrocket as you build Concrete Huts and Skyscrapers. The Mining Drill helps keep your mineral income high enough to support these massive construction projects.
  3. Geologist Synergy: While the Mining Drill specifically helps Miners, it works alongside Geologist upgrades (like Geodesy) to ensure your ground-based resource production remains competitive with your space-based income.

Pro Tip: If you find your mineral production is still the bottleneck for crafting Alloy, check if you have also purchased the Unobtanium Drill upgrade. It provides an even larger boost and is essential for the late-game resource grind.

item.title: Minerology Department
item.description:
The Minerology Department is a special Zebra Upgrade available in the game, primarily relevant for players exploring the Iron Will mechanics.

Acquisition and Costs

  • Prerequisite: To unlock the ability to purchase the Minerology Department, you must first research the Geology science.
  • Cost: The upgrade requires an investment of 75,000 Science and 75 Compendiums.

Core Effect

  • Meteor Yield Boost: Once purchased, minerology is taught in your Academies, which directly improves the resources you gather from falling meteors.
  • Scaling: Specifically, this upgrade grants a +1% production boost to meteor yields for every Academy you have constructed.

Player Insight

While the upgrade is designed to increase meteor yields based on your Academy count, some players have reported seeing no noticeable change in the yield of regular meteors after acquiring it. This suggests its actual impact might be bugged, extremely minor, or potentially only noticeable on special events like ivory meteors.

item.title: Mineral Axe
item.description:
The Mineral Axe is an early-game Workshop upgrade designed to significantly boost your wood production.

Costs To purchase the Mineral Axe, you will need an investment of 100 Science and 500 Minerals.

Core Effects Once acquired, the upgrade makes your Woodcutter kittens 70% more effective at their jobs, granting a direct +70% bonus to their wood output.

Strategic Importance The Mineral Axe is the very first upgrade in the “axe chain” of workshop technologies (which is eventually followed by the Iron Axe, Steel Axe, Titanium Axe, and so on). Because workshop upgrades act as multiplicative modifiers that stack alongside the production bonuses of your buildings (like Lumber Mills), acquiring the Mineral Axe and its successors is highly recommended to quickly scale up your wood economy without needing to constantly reassign your kitten population.

item.title: Mineral Hoes
item.description:
In Kittens Game, Mineral Hoes is the very first agricultural upgrade you can purchase in the Workshop. It is the essential foundation for moving your civilization away from a hunter-gatherer society toward a stable farming community.

Key Effects

  • Farmer Efficiency: It increases the effectiveness of your Farmers by +50%.
  • Early Game Survival: This is arguably the most important upgrade for surviving your first few winters. Without it, your kittens will likely starve as soon as the cold weather hits and catnip production drops.

Unlock Requirements & Cost

To see Mineral Hoes in your Workshop, you must have researched Agriculture.

To see Mineral Hoes in your Workshop, you must have researched Agriculture.

  • Science Cost: 100 Science
  • Minerals Cost: 100 Minerals
  • Prerequisite: None (it is the first tier of the Hoe series).

Strategic Value

Even though you are currently dealing with advanced late-game mechanics like Enriched Uranium and Machine Learning, Mineral Hoes remains a permanent part of your production multipliers.

  1. Multiplicative Stacking: In Kittens Game, early percentage bonuses like this are “baked in” to your base production. This +50% is eventually multiplied by your Solar Revolution, Magnetos, and Relic bonuses, making it much more powerful than it initially seems.
  2. Resource Priority: At the start of a reset, Minerals are often more abundant than Iron. This allows you to boost food production immediately without waiting for the Smelter infrastructure required for Iron Hoes.
  3. Iron Will Compatibility: Unlike most upgrades, this is actually useful in Iron Will mode because it increases the “Catnip per Tick” from Catnip Fields, even though you have no kittens assigned as Farmers.

The Hoe Progression

Tier Upgrade Bonus Requirement
1 Mineral Hoes +50% Minerals
2 Iron Hoes +30% Iron

item.title: Microwarp Reactors
item.description:
In Kittens Game, the Microwarp Reactor is a high-level Workshop upgrade that significantly enhances your space-based resource generation, particularly Unobtainium.

Key Effects

This upgrade represents an advancement in reactor technology that allows your orbital stations to function with much higher efficiency:

  • Lunar Outpost Production: It provides a +25% bonus to the Unobtainium production of your Lunar Outposts.
  • Energy Scaling: It allows your outposts to extract more resources without increasing their energy consumption, making it a critical upgrade for scaling your Time Crystal and Relic economy.

Unlock Requirements & Cost

To see Microwarp Reactors in your Workshop, you must have advanced through the Superconductors and Space tech branches:

Requirement Type Cost / Detail
Superconductors Technology The primary scientific prerequisite
Lunar Outpost Space Building You must have at least one Lunar Outpost built
Science Resource 150,000 Science
Unobtainium Resource 500 Unobtainium
Alloy Resource 5,000 Alloy

Strategic Context

Given your current focus on Enriched Uranium and Distortion, the Microwarp Reactor is one of the most important upgrades you can purchase at this stage.

  1. The Unobtainium Grind: As you know, Unobtainium is the bottleneck for almost every late-game mechanic, including Chronospheres and Cryptotheology. A 25% boost to its production is a massive accelerator for your entire civilization.
  2. Energy Management: Because it increases production without increasing power draw, it helps you maintain a positive energy balance as you build more Containment Chambers for Antimatter.
  3. Path to Eludium: Unobtainium is the key ingredient for Eludium. By increasing your Unobtainium yield, you can craft more Eludium, which is required for the “Long Range Spaceships” and outer-system missions we discussed.

Pro Tip: Before you buy this, ensure your Uranium production is stable. While the upgrade itself doesn’t use Uranium, the increased Unobtainium output will likely lead you to build more Lunar Outposts, which do consume a large amount of Uranium over time.

item.title: Mausoleum
item.description:
In Kittens Game, the Mausoleum is a late-game religious building that serves as a cornerstone for managing Temporal Distortion and scaling your high-level faith bonuses.

It represents a permanent monument to your fallen kittens, allowing their “legacy” to stabilize your timeline.

Key Effects

The Mausoleum provides three critical benefits for advanced players:

  • Distortion Reduction: It is the primary building used to reduce Temporal Distortion. Each Mausoleum provides a flat reduction to the distortion generated by Temporal Paradoxes, allowing you to farm Void more sustainably without crashing your production.
  • Solar Revolution Bonus: It increases the effectiveness of your Solar Revolution bonus. This allows your total production multiplier from faith to reach even higher levels, which is essential for late-game resource scaling.
  • Epimetheus Synergy: In the Metaphysics tree, the Mausoleum interacts with “The Codex” series of upgrades, further boosting your science and faith limits.

How to Unlock and Build

Since you are currently dealing with Enriched Uranium, you likely have most of these requirements met:

Strategic Use

  1. Void Farming: If you are building Chronospheres, you need Void. Use Mausoleums to keep your Distortion under control while your Void Resonators trigger paradoxes.
  2. Faith Caps: Once you have a high Transcendence Tier, Mausoleums are one of the few ways to continue growing your global production bonus when other buildings hit their diminishing returns.
  3. Stability: If you notice your resource production “flickering” or dropping unexpectedly, it’s likely due to high Distortion. Building 5–10 Mausoleums usually stabilizes the timeline for mid-range Void farming.

Summary of Benefits

  • Primary Purpose: Stabilizing time and boosting late-game production.
  • Scaling: Its costs scale moderately, making it a reliable place to dump excess Relics once your Cryptotheology is established.

item.title: Machine Learning
item.description:
In Kittens Game, Machine Learning is a high-level Workshop upgrade that serves as the primary bridge between your scientific research and your Artificial Intelligence infrastructure.

Key Effects

The Machine Learning upgrade provides a massive scaling bonus to your science capacity by enhancing the synergy between your computer systems and your library archives:

  • Compendium Cap Bonus: It increases the effectiveness of Data Centers (the Library upgrade). Specifically, it boosts the amount of maximum science you gain from each Compendium you own.
  • AI Synergy: Once you have AI Cores, Machine Learning allows those cores to further increase the science cap bonus provided by Data Centers. This makes it an essential upgrade for reaching the multi-million science caps required for Relic and Void technologies.

Unlock Requirements & Cost

To see Machine Learning in your Workshop, you must have advanced through the Robotics and AI tech branches:

Requirement Type Cost / Detail

Data Center Library Upgrade You must have upgraded your Libraries
Science Resource 150,000 Science
Blueprint Resource 100 Blueprints

Strategic Context

Given your current focus on Enriched Uranium and Distortion, Machine Learning is the upgrade that will allow you to stop worrying about your Science cap.

  1. The “Science Wall”: In the late game, technologies and space missions start costing hundreds of thousands (or millions) of science. Machine Learning, combined with a large stack of Compendiums, is how you break through this wall without needing to build thousands of buildings.
  2. AI Management: Since you are building AI Cores, remember to monitor your Gigaflops. If you let your AI level reach 15 without proper consumption (via Entanglement Stations), you will trigger the AI Apocalypse, which will devastate your resource stocks (including your Uranium!).
  3. Efficiency: This upgrade turns your “dead” resources (Compendiums) into active scaling power. It is one of the most efficient ways to use your blueprints in the mid-to-late game transition.

Pro Tip: Pair Machine Learning with the Neural Networks upgrade. This further enhances your kittens’ ability to generate science, effectively allowing you to move kittens out of the Scientist role and into more productive jobs like Engineer or Geologist.

item.title: Jupiter
item.description:
In Kittens Game, Jupiter is a pivotal location in the Space tab that marks your transition from basic lunar exploration to heavy industrialization. It is the primary gateway to the “Farther Ring” of the solar system.

Key Buildings & Missions

  • Jupiter Mission: Launching this mission unlocks the planet. It is relatively expensive in the mid-game, requiring a significant amount of Starcharts and Rocket Fuel.
  • Saturn Mission: Reaching Jupiter is a strict prerequisite for advancing to Saturn and the outer reaches of the system.
  • HE-Fuel (Hydro-Electric Fuel): Jupiter allows you to start utilizing hydrogen-based resources more effectively, which is essential for scaling your Rocketry efforts.

Strategic Importance

For a player at your stage—managing Enriched Uranium and Distortion—Jupiter serves a few specialized roles:
item.content:encoded:
In Kittens Game, Jupiter is a pivotal location in the Space tab that marks your transition from basic lunar exploration to heavy industrialization. It is the primary gateway to the “Farther Ring” of the solar system.

Key Buildings & Missions

  • Jupiter Mission: Launching this mission unlocks the planet. It is relatively expensive in the mid-game, requiring a significant amount of Starcharts and Rocket Fuel.
  • Saturn Mission: Reaching Jupiter is a strict prerequisite for advancing to Saturn and the outer reaches of the system.
  • HE-Fuel (Hydro-Electric Fuel): Jupiter allows you to start utilizing hydrogen-based resources more effectively, which is essential for scaling your Rocketry efforts.

Strategic Importance

For a player at your stage—managing Enriched Uranium and Distortion—Jupiter serves a few specialized roles:

  1. Science Cap Scaling: Jupiter-related missions and buildings are often the key to pushing your Science Max into the range required for Antimatter and Relic technologies.
  2. Unobtainium Boost: While the Moon is your first source, Jupiter (and its moons in certain versions/mods) provides the infrastructure needed to automate and accelerate your Unobtainium grind.
  3. Space Elevators: Improving your presence at Jupiter often complements your Space Elevators, reducing the friction of moving resources between the ground and your orbital stations.

Managing the Starchart Bottleneck

If you are struggling to afford the Jupiter mission or its upgrades, remember the Hubble Space Telescope upgrade we discussed. It will provide the 30% boost to your Satellites and Research Vessels needed to generate the thousands of starcharts required for Jupiter operations.

item.title: Long Range Spaceships
item.description:
This tech is part of the locked Space Exploration tree.

The Evolution of Long-Range Missions

  • Research Vessel: Your first true “explorer.” While not long-range by late-game standards, these are vital for generating the Starcharts required to calculate the trajectories for further missions.
  • Terraforming Station: Required for missions to navigation-heavy locations. These stations help stabilize your presence on distant planets, allowing for more permanent resource extraction.
  • Space Beacon: These are the pinnacle of your long-range infrastructure. They provide a massive boost to Starchart production and are necessary to “light the way” to the Centaurus System, the furthest reach of the standard game.

Requirements for Deep Space Travel

As you push into the Farther Ring, the resource costs shift from basic metals to high-energy components:

As you push into the Farther Ring, the resource costs shift from basic metals to high-energy components:

Resource Primary Purpose
Enriched Uranium Used as high-density fuel for reactors and long-range propulsion.
Antimatter Required for the most advanced vessels and the Centaurus mission.
Eludium An alloy of Unobtainium and Alloy used for hulls that can withstand interstellar travel.

Strategic Impact

By the time you are building missions for the Farther Ring, your focus is likely on two things:

  1. Unobtainium Scaling: Long-range missions to places like Cath and Umbra are designed to significantly increase your Unobtainium storage and production.
  2. The Time Paradox: Deep space travel is often a prerequisite for Chronotheology. You need the resources from these distant systems to build the Chronospheres that allow you to reset and keep your progress.

Pro Tip: If you are hitting a “Starchart bottleneck” while trying to launch these ships, ensure you have the Hubble Space Telescope upgrade we discussed earlier; it makes every Research Vessel and Satellite 30% more effective.

item.title: Knowledge Sharing
item.description:
In Kittens Game, Knowledge Sharing is a mid-game Workshop upgrade that significantly streamlines your science progression by allowing your kittens to “learn from each other” more effectively.

Key Effects

The primary function of Knowledge Sharing is to increase your Science production based on your population and infrastructure:

  • Science Generation: It provides a +10% bonus to all Science production.
  • Scholar Efficiency: It specifically boosts the effectiveness of Scholars. In the mid-game, Scholars are your primary way of reaching high Science caps for technologies like Electricity and Industrialization.
  • Cultural Synergy: It improves the rate at which Manuscripts are consumed or utilized for certain scientific breakthroughs, making it easier to maintain your “Culture” levels.

Requirements to Unlock

To see Knowledge Sharing in your Workshop, you must have advanced through the basic educational technologies:

Strategic Value

Given that you are managing Enriched Uranium and Distortion, Knowledge Sharing is a fundamental building block you likely acquired to scale your Science cap. Here is why it remains relevant in the late game:

  1. Reaching the Antimatter Era: To unlock Antimatter and Relic-based technologies, you need Science caps in the millions. Knowledge Sharing acts as a multiplier that makes every Library, Academy, and BioLab more potent.
  2. Reset Efficiency: When you reset (especially with Chronospheres), Knowledge Sharing is one of the early upgrades you want to grab to quickly regain your tech tree progress.
  3. Leader Synergy: If your Leader is a Scientist, the Knowledge Sharing bonus stacks with the Leader’s rank bonus, allowing for massive bursts of Science generation.

Pro Tip: If you find yourself “Science-capped” (unable to afford the next tech even when your storage is full), focus on building more BioLabs and Compendiums. Knowledge Sharing will then apply its percentage bonus to that higher base.

item.title: Ironwood Huts
item.description:
In Kittens Game, the Ironwood Hut is an essential early-to-mid game Workshop upgrade that allows your civilization to grow beyond its initial limits. It represents an advancement in construction technology, allowing you to use more durable materials for kitten housing.

Key Effects

The primary purpose of Ironwood Huts is to increase your maximum population:

  • Housing Capacity: It increases the number of kittens that can live in each Hut by +0.5.
  • Population Growth: Since more kittens mean more workers (and more science/production), this is one of the most important upgrades for scaling your civilization.
  • Logistics: It does not increase the physical footprint or price of the Huts themselves; it simply makes the existing ones more efficient.

Unlock Requirements & Cost

To see this upgrade in your Workshop, you must have researched Construction.

To see this upgrade in your Workshop, you must have researched Construction.

  • Science Cost: 30,000 Science
  • Wood Cost: 15,000 Wood
  • Iron Cost: 3,000 Iron

Strategic Importance

Given your progress with Enriched Uranium and Distortion, you likely bought this long ago, but it remains a pillar of your “Price Ratio” strategy:

  1. Metaphysics Synergy: Ironwood Huts are the first in a long line of housing upgrades (followed by Concrete Huts, Unobtainium Huts, etc.). These upgrades are the primary way you reach the high population counts (70+) needed to start earning significant Paragon upon resetting.
  2. Early Bottleneck: The 30,000 Science cost is often the first major “wall” players hit. Reaching this milestone usually requires building several Libraries and Academies, or assigning more kittens to the Scientist role.
  3. Iron Management: Since it requires 3,000 Iron, it often competes with Iron Hoes or Steamworks for your resources. Usually, prioritizing housing (and thus more kittens) is the better long-term move.

Comparison: Housing Upgrades

Upgrade Population Bonus Required Tech
Ironwood Huts +0.5 Kittens / Hut Construction
Concrete Huts +0.5 Kittens / Hut Mechanization
Unobtainium Huts +0.5 Kittens / Hut Unobtainium

item.title: Iron Hoes
item.description:
In Kittens Game, Iron Hoes is an essential early-game Workshop upgrade that improves your food security and population scaling.

Key Effects

  • Farmer Efficiency: It makes your Farmers 30% more effective at producing catnip.
  • Production Bonus: This is a flat multiplicative bonus to the catnipRatio, meaning every kitten assigned as a Farmer will produce more catnip per tick.

Unlock Requirements & Cost

To see this upgrade in your Workshop tab, you must have researched Agriculture and built at least one Workshop.

Unlock Requirements & Cost

To see this upgrade in your Workshop tab, you must have researched Agriculture and built at least one Workshop.

  • Science Cost: 200 Science
  • Iron Cost: 25 Iron
  • Prerequisite: You must first purchase Mineral Hoes (which provides a +50% bonus).

Strategic Value

Given your current progress with advanced tech like Enriched Uranium, Iron Hoes is a fundamental “legacy” upgrade you likely purchased hundreds of thousands of years ago in game-time.

  1. Early Game: It is the “make or break” upgrade for your first winter. Without it, you often cannot support enough kittens to generate the science needed for Mathematics or Construction.
  2. Iron Will Mode: If you are playing in Iron Will (no kittens), this upgrade is essentially useless, as you have no Farmers to receive the bonus.
  3. Late Game Synergy: While 30% seems small when you have Solar Revolution and Cryotheology active, these early base-level bonuses are still calculated into your total production multipliers. They help keep your “Catnip per Tick” high enough that you can ignore your food supply entirely and focus your kittens on being Engineers or Scientists.

Comparison: Hoes vs. Axes

It is common to compare Hoes with the Axe series of upgrades:

Upgrade Bonus Target Job Cost Type
Mineral Hoes +50% Farmer Minerals
Iron Hoes +30% Farmer Iron
Mineral Axe +70% Woodcutter Minerals
Iron Axe +50% Woodcutter Iron

item.title: Immortalism
item.description:
In Kittens Game, Immortalism is a high-level Metaphysics upgrade that fundamentally changes how your kittens interact with the cycle of life and death—specifically concerning their rank and experience.

Key Effects

The primary function of Immortalism is to preserve the progress of your kittens across certain game events:

  • Experience Retention: Normally, when a kitten dies or a reset occurs without certain upgrades, their accumulated experience and rank are lost. Immortalism allows kittens to retain their rank and XP even after they “die” from age or other factors (though they still need to be replaced by new kittens).
  • Leader Longevity: It is particularly useful for maintaining high-level Leaders. Since leaders provide bonuses based on their rank (like production boosts or price reductions), keeping those ranks intact is vital for efficiency.
  • Reduced Micromanagement: You won’t have to spend as much time re-assigning and re-leveling leaders in very long runs.

How to Unlock

To access Immortalism, you must have unlocked the Metaphysics tab (which requires the Astronomy and Philosophy technologies and at least one Ziggurat).

  • Cost: 150 Paragon.
  • Prerequisite: You must first purchase the malkuth (or similar lower-tier) Metaphysics upgrades.

Strategic Context: Is it worth it?

Since you are currently managing complex systems like Enriched Uranium and Distortion, here is how Immortalism fits into your late-game strategy:

  1. Paragon Efficiency: Early on, 150 Paragon is better spent on “Price Ratio” upgrades (like Engineering or Golden Ratio). However, once you have your core ratio upgrades, Immortalism is a great “quality of life” purchase.
  2. Long Runs (Dark Future): In runs where you are pushing toward Year 40,000+, your kittens will inevitably go through many cycles. Immortalism ensures that your workforce remains “elite” without constant intervention.
  3. Synergy with Cryptotheology: As you build more Black Obelisks, your production bonuses skyrocket. Having high-ranked kitten engineers and scientists further multiplies these bonuses, making Immortalism a solid late-game investment.

Expert Tip: If you are planning a Reset soon to farm Paragon, make sure you’ve spent your current Paragon on these permanent upgrades first, as they persist across all future timelines!

item.title: Hydro Plant Turbines
item.description:
In Kittens Game, the Hydro Plant Turbine is not a standalone building but a powerful Workshop upgrade for your Hydro Plants. It represents an engineering improvement that extracts significantly more energy from your existing water infrastructure.

Key Effects

This upgrade is essential for managing your late-game energy grid, especially when scaling up Reactors and Containment Chambers:

  • Energy Production: It increases the energy output of each Hydro Plant by +15%.
  • Scaling: Because Hydro Plants are one of the few non-pollution-generating power sources, this upgrade is a “clean” way to boost your total wattage without increasing your Magneto fuel consumption or Pollution levels.

How to Unlock and Craft

To see this upgrade in your Workshop, you need to reach a specific technological threshold:

To see this upgrade in your Workshop, you need to reach a specific technological threshold:

Requirement Type Cost / Detail
Mechanization Technology The primary tech requirement
Hydro Plant Building You must have at least one Hydro Plant built
Science Resource 25,000 Science
Energy Resource 500 Energy (Total grid capacity)

Strategic Context

Given your current focus on Enriched Uranium and Distortion management, the Hydro Plant Turbine serves a specific role:

  1. Antimatter Production: Generating Antimatter requires a massive energy surplus. Upgrading your turbines is a high-efficiency way to reach the required energy thresholds for Containment Chambers.
  2. Unobtanium Farming: Since Lunar Outposts consume significant power, this upgrade helps keep your outposts running while you focus your Uranium on enrichment rather than simple power generation.
  3. Pollution Control: Unlike coal-fired Steamworks, upgraded Hydro Plants provide consistent power without triggering the climate penalties that can slow down your kitten production in very long runs.

Pro Tip: If you have already researched Electronics, pair this with Photovoltaic Cells for your Satellites to maximize your “green” energy output before you have to rely heavily on Thorium or Fusion.

item.title: Hunting_Armour
item.description:
Hunting Armour is a highly impactful Workshop upgrade designed to significantly increase the rare resources you gather from sending your kittens on hunts.

Acquisition and Costs

  • Prerequisite: To unlock this upgrade in your Workshop, you must first research the Metal Working science.
  • Cost: Purchasing Hunting Armour requires an investment of 2,000 Science and 750 Iron.

Core Effects and Yields

  • The Bonus: The upgrade makes your hunters three times as effective by granting a massive +2.0 to your global hunting bonus.
  • Resource Multiplier: This flat bonus translates to roughly a 165% to 200% increase in the basic amounts of furs and ivory you receive from each hunt.
  • Stacking: Assuming you have already purchased the previous hunting upgrade, Bolas (which provides +1.0), acquiring Hunting Armour will bring your total hunting bonus to 3.0. With this combined multiplier, an average hunt is expected to yield approximately 136.50 furs and 42.00 ivory.

Strategic Value

Acquiring Hunting Armour is often viewed as a major progression milestone, especially during standard mid-game progression or restrictive challenge runs like Iron Will. Because it drastically scales up your fur and ivory income, it directly alleviates the bottleneck for crafting parchment and manuscripts, allowing you to effectively tackle the massive culture requirements needed to unlock trade races and early religion upgrades.
