The Unicorn Tomb is an early building within the Unicorn religious progression chain, serving as a direct upgrade to the Unicorn Pasture.

This structure is vital for establishing the infrastructure necessary to scale luxury and temporal resources like Tears and Time Crystals in the mid-to-late game.

Details and Effects

Category Detail
Prerequisite The Unicorn Tomb is an upgrade available after successfully building a Unicorn Pasture [1, 2].
Cost Building a Unicorn Tomb requires 5 Tears and 500 Ivory [1, 3].
Effect It provides a 5% improvement to unicorn generation (Unicorns per Tick +5%) [1, 3].
Progression Completing at least one Unicorn Tomb is the direct prerequisite for unlocking the Ivory Tower.

Context in Religious Progression

The Unicorn Tomb is placed early in the sequence of unicorn buildings that scale unicorn production and eventually lead to the coveted Time Crystal economy:

Unicorn Pasture –> Unicorn Tomb –> Ivory Tower to Ivory Citadel –> Sky Palace –> Unicorn Utopia –> Sunspire

The entire chain is essential because the Unicorns generated are later sacrificed in Ziggurats to produce Tears, which are required to build the Unicorn Tomb itself and subsequent structures.

Challenge Reward

The Unicorn Tomb gains a special utility if you complete the Unicorn Tears challenge. As the base reward for completing this challenge, Unicorn Tombs receive the additional benefit of increasing maximum faith based on Transcendence Tier.

item.title: Tears
item.description:
Tears are a critical resource associated with the Unicorn progression pathway, categorizing as a Unique Resource and a Luxury Resource in Kittens Game [1, 2]. They are essential inputs for escalating the religious infrastructure and advancing toward the mid-to-late-game economy, particularly by leading to the highly valuable Black Liquid Sorrow (BLS) [3-5].

Acquisition and Persistence

Tears are acquired exclusively through a specific religious action:

  • Production via Sacrifice: Tears are gained by sacrificing unicorns [1, 6].
  • Scaling with Ziggurats: Each time unicorns are sacrificed (an action costing 2500 unicorns) [6, 7], the amount of tears received is equal to the total number of Ziggurats the player has built [6, 7]. Therefore, players are advised to construct a minimum of 10, or preferably 25–30, Ziggurats before converting unicorns to maximize the efficiency of Tear generation [7, 8].
  • Loss on Reset: As a luxury resource, Tears are lost upon game reset, alongside Furs, Ivory, Spice, Unicorns, Alicorns, and Necrocorns [1, 2].

Uses and Strategic Importance

Tears are consumed for two primary purposes: investing in powerful religious infrastructure and producing the required resources for the endgame:
item.content:encoded:
Tears are a critical resource associated with the Unicorn progression pathway, categorizing as a Unique Resource and a Luxury Resource in Kittens Game [1, 2]. They are essential inputs for escalating the religious infrastructure and advancing toward the mid-to-late-game economy, particularly by leading to the highly valuable Black Liquid Sorrow (BLS) [3-5].

Acquisition and Persistence

Tears are acquired exclusively through a specific religious action:

  • Production via Sacrifice: Tears are gained by sacrificing unicorns [1, 6].
  • Scaling with Ziggurats: Each time unicorns are sacrificed (an action costing 2500 unicorns) [6, 7], the amount of tears received is equal to the total number of Ziggurats the player has built [6, 7]. Therefore, players are advised to construct a minimum of 10, or preferably 25–30, Ziggurats before converting unicorns to maximize the efficiency of Tear generation [7, 8].
  • Loss on Reset: As a luxury resource, Tears are lost upon game reset, alongside Furs, Ivory, Spice, Unicorns, Alicorns, and Necrocorns [1, 2].

Uses and Strategic Importance

Tears are consumed for two primary purposes: investing in powerful religious infrastructure and producing the required resources for the endgame:

  1. Building Unicorn Structures: Tears are necessary for constructing increasingly potent religious buildings that scale unicorn production and further the resource chain:

    • Unicorn Tomb: Costs 5 Tears and 500 Ivory [9].
    • Ivory Tower: Costs 25 Tears and 25,000 Ivory [10].
    • Ivory Citadel: Costs 50 Tears and 50,000 Ivory [11].
    • Sky Palace: Costs 500 Tears, 125,000 Ivory, and 5 Megalith [11].
    • Unicorn Utopia: Costs 5,000 Tears and 1,000,000 Ivory [12].
    • Marker: Costs 5,000 Tears (along with Megalith, Spice, and Unobtainium) [13].

  2. Refinement to Black Liquid Sorrow (BLS): Tears are refined to create Sorrow, also known as Black Liquid Sorrow (BLS) [4, 5]. This conversion costs 10,000 Tears per 1 Sorrow [4]. BLS is a prerequisite for constructing Black Pyramids [4, 14], which are necessary to unlock the ability to trade with the Leviathans for advanced resources like Time Crystals and Relics [3, 14, 15].

This resource forms a critical loop in the game’s late progression: Unicorns $\to$ Tears $\to$ BLS $\to$ Black Pyramids, which then allows access to Time Crystals and Relics for temporal progression [3, 4].

item.title: Unic Pasture
item.description:
The Unicorn Pasture is an early-to-mid-game building in Kittens Game that plays a dual role: providing a perpetual source of the rare Unicorn resource, and offering a permanent quality-of-life improvement by reducing the Catnip consumed by your kittens.

Here is a comprehensive breakdown of the Unicorn Pasture:

1. Unlocks and Construction

  • Technology Prerequisite: The Unicorn Pasture is unlocked once you research Animal Husbandry.
  • Discovery Method: Unicorns, the primary resource required to build the pasture, have a small chance of appearing in the village each game day if you have less than 2. They are initially found via Hunting, which has a 5% chance of yielding one unicorn per hunt.
  • Cost: The base cost to build one Unicorn Pasture requires 2 Unicorns.
  • Price Ratio: The building has a price ratio of 1.75.

2. Purpose and Effects

The Unicorn Pasture provides two critical functions:
item.content:encoded:
The Unicorn Pasture is an early-to-mid-game building in Kittens Game that plays a dual role: providing a perpetual source of the rare Unicorn resource, and offering a permanent quality-of-life improvement by reducing the Catnip consumed by your kittens.

Here is a comprehensive breakdown of the Unicorn Pasture:

1. Unlocks and Construction

  • Technology Prerequisite: The Unicorn Pasture is unlocked once you research Animal Husbandry.
  • Discovery Method: Unicorns, the primary resource required to build the pasture, have a small chance of appearing in the village each game day if you have less than 2. They are initially found via Hunting, which has a 5% chance of yielding one unicorn per hunt.
  • Cost: The base cost to build one Unicorn Pasture requires 2 Unicorns.
  • Price Ratio: The building has a price ratio of 1.75.

2. Purpose and Effects

The Unicorn Pasture provides two critical functions:

  • Unicorn Generation: It produces +0.001 Unicorns per Tick. This establishes a self-sustaining source of unicorns, rather than relying solely on hunting.
  • Catnip Demand Reduction: It reduces the amount of Catnip consumed by each kitten by -0.15%. This is described as “Very handy in the long run” for managing your food supply.

3. Strategic Importance and Progression

The Unicorn Pasture is an early gateway into the complex Unicorn/Religion Era of the game:

  • Early Hunting Goal: The walkthrough advises that if you are lucky, hunting will yield unicorns, and once you “Find two Unicorns, you can create a Unicorn Pasture”.
  • Circular Function: The pasture automatically generates more unicorns, allowing you to purchase more pastures, which, in turn, further reduces Catnip consumption. This is a beneficial “circular” process.
  • Foundation for Unicorn Era: Unicorn Pastures are the starting point for the entire unicorn resource production line, which eventually leads to Tears, Black Liquid Sorrow (BLS), Alicorns, and Time Crystals.
  • Upgrades: Unicorn Pasture generation can be boosted by the Unicorn Selection workshop upgrade, which increases production by +25%.

4. Advanced Unicorn Buildings

Once the Unicorn Pasture is established, you can proceed with the religious path that utilizes Unicorns and Tears:

  • Ziggurats: Unicorns are required to build Ziggurats (unlocked by Construction). Ziggurats enable you to Sacrifice Unicorns (2500 Unicorns per sacrifice) to receive Unicorn Tears.
  • Tears Consumption: Tears are then used to purchase advanced Unicorn buildings that further boost unicorn generation, such as Unicorn Tomb, Ivory Tower, Ivory Citadel, Sky Palace, Unicorn Utopia, and Sunspire. These buildings are the key to the Unicorn/Time Crystal Era.

In essence, the Unicorn Pasture takes a rare, sporadic hunting bonus (the Unicorn) and turns it into a reliable, automated luxury resource, while simultaneously providing a permanent reduction in the cost of kitten maintenance.

item.title: Chapel
item.description:
The Chapel is a key structure in Kittens Game, categorized as a Culture building, that significantly boosts both your society’s culture and faith accumulation.

Unlocks and Construction

  • Technology Prerequisite: The Chapel is unlocked by researching the Acoustics technology.
  • Acoustics Cost: Researching Acoustics requires 60,000 Science and 60 Compendium.
  • Base Cost: The construction of a single Chapel requires a substantial investment in resources: 2000 Minerals, 250 Culture, and 250 Parchment. It has a price ratio of 1.15.

Primary Functions and Effects

The Chapel is crucial for advancing the cultural and religious aspects of your village:
item.content:encoded:
The Chapel is a key structure in Kittens Game, categorized as a Culture building, that significantly boosts both your society’s culture and faith accumulation.

Unlocks and Construction

  • Technology Prerequisite: The Chapel is unlocked by researching the Acoustics technology.
  • Acoustics Cost: Researching Acoustics requires 60,000 Science and 60 Compendium.
  • Base Cost: The construction of a single Chapel requires a substantial investment in resources: 2000 Minerals, 250 Culture, and 250 Parchment. It has a price ratio of 1.15.

Primary Functions and Effects

The Chapel is crucial for advancing the cultural and religious aspects of your village:

  1. Culture Production and Capacity:

    • It generates +0.05 Culture per Tick. Culture is a special resource generated by Amphitheatres, Temples, and Chapels, which is necessary for crafting Manuscripts.
    • It increases your Max Culture by +200.

  2. Faith Production:

    • The Chapel generates +0.005 Faith per Tick. This high rate makes the Chapel a major source of Faith.
    • Faith is an expendable resource used exclusively in the Religion tab to purchase religious upgrades and is generated by Temples, [Priests] ( /job/priest/), and Chapels (once Acoustics is researched).

The technology that unlocks the Chapel, Acoustics, is noted specifically for improving both faith and culture production.

item.title: Astronomy
item.description:
Astronomy is a crucial technology in Kittens Game that marks the shift into the industrial and space-faring phases, particularly initiating the resource gathering necessary for the Titanium era.

Technical Details and Placement

  • Prerequisite: Astronomy is unlocked by researching Theology.
  • Cost: Researching Astronomy requires 28,000 Science and 65 Manuscripts.
  • Placement in Progression: After overcoming the hurdle of acquiring Theology (which also requires Manuscripts), the next technology, Astronomy, is considered “much easier to acquire,” especially if you have a Steamworks operational to generate Manuscripts via the Printing Press upgrade.

Primary Unlocks and Effects

The research of Astronomy unlocks essential buildings and the resources needed for advancement:
item.content:encoded:
Astronomy is a crucial technology in Kittens Game that marks the shift into the industrial and space-faring phases, particularly initiating the resource gathering necessary for the Titanium era.

Technical Details and Placement

  • Prerequisite: Astronomy is unlocked by researching Theology.
  • Cost: Researching Astronomy requires 28,000 Science and 65 Manuscripts.
  • Placement in Progression: After overcoming the hurdle of acquiring Theology (which also requires Manuscripts), the next technology, Astronomy, is considered “much easier to acquire,” especially if you have a Steamworks operational to generate Manuscripts via the Printing Press upgrade.

Primary Unlocks and Effects

The research of Astronomy unlocks essential buildings and the resources needed for advancement:

  1. Observatory Building: Astronomy unlocks the Observatory building.
    • Observatories boost Science production by +25% and increase your Max Science by +1000.
    • They also improve the chance of getting science and starcharts from external events, increasing the Astronomical Event Chance by +0.2% and the Automatic Event Observation Chance by +1%.
  2. Starcharts: Astronomy enables starcharts . Starcharts are categorized as an Uncommon Resource, found by observing rare astronomical events.
  3. Navigation: Astronomy unlocks the next key technology, Navigation. Navigation subsequently unlocks other crucial techs like Architecture, Physics, and Geology.
  4. Policy/: Astronomy, in conjunction with the Diplomacy policy, unlocks foreign Policy/ such as Knowledge Sharing and Cultural Exchange.

Strategic Importance

Astronomy is strategically important because it unlocks the mechanism to acquire starcharts, a resource necessary for building Trade Ships and ultimately leading to the discovery of the Zebras, who trade essential resources like Titanium and Iron.

Before researching Astronomy, you may occasionally see a message about “astronomical events” in your log, which allows you to click a button to earn Science. However, once you research Astronomy, observing these events will yield starcharts. Because starcharts are a major bottleneck for trade expansion, building many Observatories is prioritized to increase the rate of seeing and automatically clicking on these meteors.

The goal upon reaching this point is to build enough Observatories to get starcharts at a “healthy rate” before focusing heavily on Steel production.

item.title: Navigation
item.description:
Navigation is a pivotal technology in Kittens Game, marking the transition into the trade and titanium accumulation phase by unlocking essential infrastructure, advanced crafting, and further scientific branches.

Technological Details

  • Prerequisite and Cost: Navigation is unlocked by researching Astronomy. Researching it requires 35,000 Science and 100 Manuscript.
  • Scientific Path: Successfully researching Navigation unlocks the next three critical technology branches: Architecture, Physics, and Geology.
  • Strategic Timing: Players are advised to research Navigation Science once they have accumulated 25 Starcharts. The policy Clear Cutting is often recommended beforehand to provide the necessary Wood for the buildings and ships unlocked by Navigation.

Key Unlocks

Navigation introduces the ability to build advanced transportation and storage structures:
item.content:encoded:
Navigation is a pivotal technology in Kittens Game, marking the transition into the trade and titanium accumulation phase by unlocking essential infrastructure, advanced crafting, and further scientific branches.

Technological Details

  • Prerequisite and Cost: Navigation is unlocked by researching Astronomy. Researching it requires 35,000 Science and 100 Manuscript.
  • Scientific Path: Successfully researching Navigation unlocks the next three critical technology branches: Architecture, Physics, and Geology.
  • Strategic Timing: Players are advised to research Navigation Science once they have accumulated 25 Starcharts. The policy Clear Cutting is often recommended beforehand to provide the necessary Wood for the buildings and ships unlocked by Navigation.

Key Unlocks

Navigation introduces the ability to build advanced transportation and storage structures:

1. Trade and Crafting

Navigation enables the crafting of Trade Ships.

  • Trade Ships are essential for discovering new civilizations through the “Explore” function.
  • Trade Ships are critical for reaching the Titanium era, as they are the major upgrade for obtaining more Titanium through trading with Zebras.
  • Crafting a Trade Ship initially requires 100 Scaffold, 150 Plate, and 25 Starchart.

2. Building Unlocks

Navigation unlocks the Harbour building.

  • Harbours provide substantial increases to storage capacity for several key common resources:
    • Catnip: +2500.
    • Wood, Minerals, Iron, Coal, Gold, and Titanium storage limits are all increased.
    • The Expanded Cargo upgrade (unlocked by Navigation) further increases Harbour capacity by 1% per trade ship, up to a limit of 225%.

3. Workshop Upgrades

The technology also unlocks several important Workshop upgrades focused on resource efficiency and trade relations:

  • Caravanserai: This upgrade improves race relations by giving each Tradepost a flat 0.35% chance decrease to the hostile event probability and a 0.175% increase to the friendly event probability.
  • Titanium Axe: Improves Woodcutters’ output by 50%.
  • Astrolabe: Improves Observatory effectiveness.
  • Titanium Reflectors: Increases the maximum science storage bonus derived from Libraries/Data Centers based on the number of Observatories you have.

Navigation acts as a necessary gateway, like plotting a course to a new continent, enabling the building of the ships (Trade Ships) and port infrastructure (Harbours) needed to access lucrative resources (Titanium and Iron) from distant, often hostile, civilizations.

item.title: Nuclear Fission
item.description:
Nuclear Fission is a pivotal technology research in the late mid-game, crucial for advancing your industrial infrastructure, especially regarding energy production, titanium refinement, and unlocking access to Uranium trade.

Unlocking and Cost

  • Prerequisite: Nuclear Fission is unlocked after researching Electronics.
  • Cost: Researching Nuclear Fission requires 150,000 Science and 100 Blueprint.

Key Unlocks and Effects

Nuclear Fission provides both industrial capacity and scientific progression:

  1. Building Unlocked: Reactor

    • It unlocks the Reactor mega-structure.
    • The Reactor costs 3500 Titanium, 5000 Plate, 50 Concrete, and 25 Blueprint.
    • It provides a substantial +5% Global Production bonus.
    • It generates +10 Energy but consumes Uranium at a rate of 0.001 per Tick.
    • It also increases maximum Uranium storage by +250.

  2. Workshop Upgrades

    • Nuclear Smelters: This upgrade allows existing Smelters to produce Titanium at a rate of 0.0015 per tick. This provides a domestic source for the critical resource Titanium.
    • Reactor Vessel: This upgrade improves the ship potential for expanded Harbour capacity, specifically increasing the Harbour capacity limit by 5% per active Reactor past the 225% limit.

  3. Technology Progression

    • Nuclear Fission unlocks two major scientific pathways: Nanotechnology and Particle Physics.

Strategic Importance

This technology is a mandatory gateway for the Uranium and space exploration phases:

  • Unlocking Dragons: Nuclear Fission is the prerequisite for establishing trade relations with the Dragons. Dragons are essential because they sell Uranium in exchange for Titanium (250 units). Uranium is a vital resource for advanced structures and technologies.
  • Uranium Management: The Reactor, unlocked here, helps manage the newly introduced Uranium resource by increasing its storage capacity.
  • Global Production: The Reactor’s +5% Global Production bonus makes it an attractive investment, helping to boost all resource outputs.

The research path proceeds as part of the broader industrialisation effort: Physics $\to$ Electricity $\to$ Industrialization $\to$ Electronics $\to$ Nuclear Fission.

item.title: Architecture
item.description:
Architecture is a key mid-game technology research that advances your infrastructure by unlocking new buildings, particularly high-tier housing and structures crucial for gold management.

Here is a detailed breakdown of the Architecture technology:

1. Requirements and Cost

  • Prerequisite: Architecture is unlocked after researching Navigation.
  • Cost: Researching Architecture requires 42,000 Science and 10 Compendium.
  • Progression: Architecture is part of the research path following Astronomy and Navigation.

2. Buildings Unlocked

Architecture unlocks two important mid-game structures: the Mansion and the Mint.
item.content:encoded:
Architecture is a key mid-game technology research that advances your infrastructure by unlocking new buildings, particularly high-tier housing and structures crucial for gold management.

Here is a detailed breakdown of the Architecture technology:

1. Requirements and Cost

  • Prerequisite: Architecture is unlocked after researching Navigation.
  • Cost: Researching Architecture requires 42,000 Science and 10 Compendium.
  • Progression: Architecture is part of the research path following Astronomy and Navigation.

2. Buildings Unlocked

Architecture unlocks two important mid-game structures: the Mansion and the Mint.

Building Cost and Purpose Details
Mansion High-tier housing. Costs 185 Slab, 75 Steel, and 25 Titanium. Provides +1 maximum kitten and +50 maximum catpower.
Mint Structure for managing gold and generating rare resources. Costs 5,000 Minerals, 200 Plate, and 500 Gold. Mints increase gold storage capacity and can generate Furs and Ivory in exchange for Catpower and Gold consumption.

3. Strategic Importance

  • Population Growth: Mansions provide additional population capacity, helping sustain kitten growth.
  • Resource Management: Mints are useful for increasing your gold storage limit, which helps unlock useful culture and catpower bonuses available in the Religion tab. Running Mints temporarily when idling is helpful to stockpile furs.
  • Progression: Architecture is required to unlock the next technology, Acoustics.

In the accelerated progression for short runs, Architecture is one of the technologies targeted early on, costing a total of 70 Compendia (when combined with Acoustics).

item.title: Biochemistry
item.description:
Biochemistry is an advanced scientific technology research in Kittens Game, situated on the technology tree after Biology. It is essential for unlocking critical infrastructure related to oil production and catnip refinement.

Here is a breakdown of the technology:

Unlocking and Cost

  • Prerequisite: Biochemistry is unlocked by successfully researching Biology.
  • Cost: Researching Biochemistry requires a high amount of resources: 145,000 Science and 500 Compendiums.

Key Unlocks and Effects

Researching Biochemistry opens access to the next scientific field and provides a crucial Workshop upgrade:
item.content:encoded:
Biochemistry is an advanced scientific technology research in Kittens Game, situated on the technology tree after Biology. It is essential for unlocking critical infrastructure related to oil production and catnip refinement.

Here is a breakdown of the technology:

Unlocking and Cost

  • Prerequisite: Biochemistry is unlocked by successfully researching Biology.
  • Cost: Researching Biochemistry requires a high amount of resources: 145,000 Science and 500 Compendiums.

Key Unlocks and Effects

Researching Biochemistry opens access to the next scientific field and provides a crucial Workshop upgrade:

  1. Next Technology: Biochemistry unlocks Genetics.
  2. Workshop Upgrade (Biofuel Processing): The research enables the Biofuel Processing Workshop upgrade. This upgrade provides a significant functional benefit to the Bio Lab building (unlocked by Biology).
    • Bio Labs, with the Biofuel Processing upgrade, can automatically convert catnip into oil.
    • This conversion consumes 5 catnip per second (or 1 catnip per tick), and uses 1 Watt of Energy.
    • In exchange, the Bio Lab produces 0.10 oil per second (or 0.02 oil per tick),.

Strategic Significance

Biochemistry plays a critical role in mitigating the oil production bottleneck in the late mid-game, particularly for players facing resource constraints or engaging in specialized runs:

  • Oil Supply: By enabling Bio Labs to convert catnip to oil, Biochemistry helps players utilize massive catnip surpluses to generate industrial fuel. Oil is a common resource needed for structures like Oil Wells, Calciners, and Kerosene production,,.
  • Kerosene Production: The Oil Processing technology, unlocked by Rocketry, enables the production of Kerosene. Kerosene is a crucial fuel for space missions (like Dune Mission and Moon Mission) and the Orbital Array,,. A steady supply of oil via Biofuel Processing is fundamental to maintaining Kerosene production velocity.
  • Production Scaling: The subsequent research unlocked by Genetics is the GM Catnip upgrade, which further improves the oil yield from Bio Labs by 60%,.
  • Run Planning: Due to the high science and compendium costs, the Biology research pathway (which leads to Biochemistry) is sometimes advised to be skipped in initial runs until players can easily craft Alloy.

item.title: Biology
item.description:
Biology is a mid-to-late-game technology research that unlocks the Bio Lab building, primarily serving to significantly boost scientific capacity and facilitate the advanced production of oil.

Technology Details

  • Prerequisite: Biology is unlocked after researching Geology.
  • Cost: Researching Biology requires 85,000 Science and 100 Compendium.
  • Unlocks: Biology immediately unlocks the Bio Lab building and the subsequent research, Biochemistry.

The Bio Lab Building

The building unlocked by this technology provides major science and resource bonuses, but requires moderately advanced materials to construct:
item.content:encoded:
Biology is a mid-to-late-game technology research that unlocks the Bio Lab building, primarily serving to significantly boost scientific capacity and facilitate the advanced production of oil.

Technology Details

  • Prerequisite: Biology is unlocked after researching Geology.
  • Cost: Researching Biology requires 85,000 Science and 100 Compendium.
  • Unlocks: Biology immediately unlocks the Bio Lab building and the subsequent research, Biochemistry.

The Bio Lab Building

The building unlocked by this technology provides major science and resource bonuses, but requires moderately advanced materials to construct:

Category Detail
Cost 100 Slab, 25 Alloy, and 1500 Science.
Science Effect Provides a +35% Science bonus and increases Max Science by +1500 per Bio Lab.
Refinement Increases Catnip refinement by +10%.

Strategic Significance

Biology and the Bio Lab are important for players pushing toward the endgame, particularly for managing science bottlenecks and expanding energy production:

  1. Science Capacity: Bio Labs are used to reach very high science capacity limits (e.g., 125K maximum Science) for late-game research, reducing the need to rely on continuously constructing expensive Observatories or Temples.
  2. Industrial Transition: Biology is vital for entering the advanced energy era. It leads to Biochemistry, which unlocks the Biofuel Processing upgrade. This upgrade allows Bio Labs to convert catnip into oil at a rate of 0.10 oil per second, consuming 5 catnip per second and 1 Watt of energy. This automation is useful for overcoming oil production bottlenecks.
  3. Cross-Building Synergy: Bio Labs are connected to Data Centers (upgraded Libraries) via the Uplink and Starlink workshop upgrades, which provide reciprocal increases to maximum science, culture, and compendium caps between the two building types.
  4. Early Game Recommendation: Due to the relatively high science, Compendium, Slab, and Alloy costs of this research and its resulting building, players are generally advised to skip Biology on their first couple of runs. It becomes worthwhile once players can easily craft Alloy.

For complex industrial advancement, researching Biology helps convert your massive catnip surplus into critical industrial fuel (oil), which is essential for powering advanced space and factory structures.

item.title: Combustion
item.description:
Combustion is a key technology research in the late mid-game of Kittens Game, primarily focused on boosting the efficiency of your industrial facilities, particularly manuscript printing and oil production.

Research Details and Cost

Category Detail
Prerequisite Combustion is unlocked after researching Industrialization.
Cost Researching Combustion requires 115,000 Science and 45 Blueprint.
Next Technology Combustion directly unlocks the Ecology science.
Progression Path This technology is part of the progression toward the Concrete era: Physics $\to$ Electricity $\to$ Industrialization $\to$ Combustion or Mechanization.

Key Workshop Upgrades

Combustion unlocks three important Workshop upgrades designed to enhance energy and production processes:
item.content:encoded:
Combustion is a key technology research in the late mid-game of Kittens Game, primarily focused on boosting the efficiency of your industrial facilities, particularly manuscript printing and oil production.

Research Details and Cost

Category Detail
Prerequisite Combustion is unlocked after researching Industrialization.
Cost Researching Combustion requires 115,000 Science and 45 Blueprint.
Next Technology Combustion directly unlocks the Ecology science.
Progression Path This technology is part of the progression toward the Concrete era: Physics $\to$ Electricity $\to$ Industrialization $\to$ Combustion or Mechanization.

Key Workshop Upgrades

Combustion unlocks three important Workshop upgrades designed to enhance energy and production processes:

  1. Oil Refinery
    • This upgrade improves the effectiveness of Oil Wells by 35% (additive with other effects). This is vital for addressing the oil bottleneck as the game progresses.
  2. Offset Press
    • This upgrade significantly boosts the automated production of Manuscripts by Steamworks. It increases the Printing Press production rate by a factor of 4, raising the output to 0.01 manuscripts per second.
  3. Fuel Injector
    • This upgrade helps mitigate the energy cost of industrialisation by reducing the coal consumption of Steamworks by 20%.

Strategic Context

Combustion is one of the important industrial technologies to target in the mid-game, alongside Metallurgy and Electronics. The upgrades unlocked by Combustion are crucial for maintaining the resource flow necessary for space and high-tier infrastructure development, particularly by improving oil supply for structures like Oil Wells and Kerosene production.

item.title: Construction
item.description:
Construction is a critical early-to- mid-game technology research that fundamentally transforms your village by introducing new resource management tools and advanced housing options. It is essential for continuing scientific progression and scaling your infrastructure.

Technology Details

Category Detail
Cost 1300 Science.
Prerequisite Unlocked by Animal Husbandry.
Unlocks Engineering (next research).

Key Buildings Unlocked

Researching Construction unlocks four key buildings that help expand your village capabilities:

  1. Log House: This is a tier-up housing structure that costs 200 Wood and 250 Minerals. It provides +1 maximum kitten and +50 maximum catpower. Log Houses are often prioritised early to continue maximizing population.
  2. Lumber Mill: This industrial structure costs 100 Wood, 50 Iron, and 250 Minerals. It increases Wood production by +10%.
  3. Warehouse: This is an important storage building costing 1.5 Beam and 2 Slab. Warehouses initially do not store Catnip but increase the maximum limits of Wood, Minerals, Iron, Coal, Gold, and Titanium. They eventually upgrade to Spaceports.
  4. Ziggurat: This is a mega-structure building that serves as a prerequisite for the Unicorn/Time Crystal Era. It costs 50 Megalith, 50 Scaffold, and 1 Blueprint and increases Max Culture by +8%.

Effects and Strategic Importance

The research also provides crucial operational enhancements:

Technology Details

  2. Lumber Mill: This industrial structure costs 100 Wood, 50 Iron, and 250 Minerals. It increases Wood production by +10%.
  3. Warehouse: This is an important storage building costing 1.5 Beam and 2 Slab. Warehouses initially do not store Catnip but increase the maximum limits of Wood, Minerals, Iron, Coal, Gold, and Titanium. They eventually upgrade to Spaceports.
  4. Ziggurat: This is a mega-structure building that serves as a prerequisite for the Unicorn/Time Crystal Era. It costs 50 Megalith, 50 Scaffold, and 1 Blueprint and increases Max Culture by +8%.

Effects and Strategic Importance

The research also provides crucial operational enhancements:

  • Enables Crafting: Construction formally enables crafting operations in the Workshop. This allows basic resource inputs to be converted into complex materials.
  • Workshop Upgrades: It unlocks several useful upgrades:
    • Composite Bow: Provides a permanent +50% boost to Catpower production from Hunters.
    • Catnip Enrichment: Improves Catnip refinement efficiency by reducing the cost of wood crafting from 100 Catnip to 50 Catnip.
    • Reinforced Saw: Improves Lumber Mill efficiency by an additional +20%.

Strategically, players are advised to push for Construction science early to establish Log Houses for population growth and Lumber Mills to improve wood output, as wood accumulates slowly before this point.

As a general action, commencing construction on a civilization begins when you start gathering catnip to expand the game. Buildings are often kept hidden until you have at least 30% of the necessary resources to construct the first one.

item.title: Electricity
item.description:
The research Electricity is a critical mid-game technology in Kittens Game, enabling the expansion of your industrial and energy infrastructure.

Unlocking and Cost

  • Prerequisite: Electricity is unlocked after researching Physics. Physics itself requires 50,000 Science and 35 Compendiums.
  • Cost: Researching Electricity requires 75,000 Science and 85 Compendiums.

Strategic Role and Progression

Electricity is a vital step in the technological chain, leading to higher levels of industrial and space technology:

  • Building Unlocked: Researching Electricity unlocks the Magneto building. Magnetos are crucial industrial structures that provide a +2% Global Production bonus and +5 Energy.
  • Next Technology: Electricity unlocks the subsequent research branch, Industrialization.
  • Late-Game Path: Electricity is part of the progression required to reach advanced technologies such as Mechanization (which enables Concrete). The technology line progresses through Physics $\to$ Electricity $\to$ Industrialization $\to$ Mechanization.
  • Electronics Unlock: The Industrialization branch, unlocked by Electricity, eventually leads to the Electronics science. Electronics unlocks critical utility upgrades, including SETI (which automates astronomical events for Starchart acquisition) and enables the upgrade of Libraries to Data Centers.

In the mid-game, Electricity is listed alongside Chemistry, Acoustics, and Geology as a research option, noted for advancing the player “one step closer to something useful”.

item.title: Machinery
item.description:
Machinery is a crucial mid-game technology research in Kittens Game, enabling automated production and unlocking the specialized Steamworks building.

Unlocking and Cost

  • Prerequisite Technology: Machinery is unlocked by researching Writing.
  • Cost: Researching Machinery requires 15,000 Science.
  • Strategic Context: Machinery is one of three major sciences unlocked by Writing, alongside Philosophy and Steel. Compared to Philosophy (which leads directly to Theology and further advancement), Machinery is initially viewed as a “specialist Tech that won’t help you much right now”.

Key Unlocks and Effects

Researching Machinery is essential for advancing industrial automation and resource production:
item.content:encoded:
Machinery is a crucial mid-game technology research in Kittens Game, enabling automated production and unlocking the specialized Steamworks building.

Unlocking and Cost

  • Prerequisite Technology: Machinery is unlocked by researching Writing.
  • Cost: Researching Machinery requires 15,000 Science.
  • Strategic Context: Machinery is one of three major sciences unlocked by Writing, alongside Philosophy and Steel. Compared to Philosophy (which leads directly to Theology and further advancement), Machinery is initially viewed as a “specialist Tech that won’t help you much right now”.

Key Unlocks and Effects

Researching Machinery is essential for advancing industrial automation and resource production:

  1. Buildings: Machinery unlocks the Steamworks building. Steamworks require Steel (65 units), Gear (20 units), and Blueprint (1 unit) to construct.

  2. Upgrades: Machinery unlocks several key Workshop upgrades:

    • Printing Press: Allows Steamworks to automatically produce Manuscripts. This provides an alternative pathway for resource acquisition, as manually getting Manuscripts requires hunting Furs for Parchment and accumulating Culture.
    • Workshop Automation: Causes Steamworks to convert specific basic resources (Wood to Beams, Minerals to Slabs) when those resources are near their storage cap.
    • Crossbow: A permanent upgrade that boosts Catpower production from Hunters.

Strategic Significance (Steamworks)

The primary strategic importance of Machinery lies in the capabilities of the Steamworks:

  • Manuscript Automation: Steamworks, when paired with the Printing Press upgrade, consume Coal to automatically print manuscripts. This is helpful for overcoming the “fair bump” or hurdle presented by the high Manuscript requirements for advancing science (like Theology).
  • Energy and Boost: Steamworks provide +1 Energy and a significant +15% Magneto Boost.
  • Cost Management: Steamworks present a secondary hurdle because they require Blueprints to create, which often requires trading until their production cost can be managed.

item.title: Mathematics
item.description:
Mathematics is a crucial early-to-mid-game technology in Kittens Game, primarily focused on expanding your scientific capacity and unlocking the Academy building.

Technology Overview

Detail Specification
Cost 1000 Science,.
Prerequisite Unlocked by Animal Husbandry,.
Unlocks Academy (building),; Celestial Mechanics (workshop upgrade),.

The Academy Building

The Academy is the key building unlocked by this research, offering significant bonuses to science and culture accumulation:

  • Cost: 50 Wood, 70 Minerals, and 100 Science.
  • Primary Effects:
    • Science Boost: Provides a +20% Science bonus.
    • Science Storage: Increases maximum Science storage by +500,.
    • Culture Storage: Increases maximum Culture capacity by +25.
    • Kitten Experience: Provides a +5% Kitten Exp bonus.

Strategic Role

Mathematics is considered “especially useful” because of the Academy’s ability to boost science accumulation and support the cultural infrastructure.

Technology Overview
